Win + R에 eventvwr.msc를 입력하고 Windows 로그 →: Press Win + R, enter eventvwr.msc, and in Windows Logs → Application find the Application Error entry that matches the launch time.
오류 모듈 이름이 게임 폴더의 파일인지, Windows 런타임 파일인지,: Determine whether the faulting module is a file in the game folder, a Windows runtime file, or an antivirus or anti-cheat file.
Visual C++·DirectX·.NET 런타임 설치하기: Install the Visual C++, DirectX and .NET runtimes
많은 게임이 Visual C++ 재배포 패키지와 DirectX 구성 요소: Many games separately require the Visual C++ Redistributable and DirectX components. If these are missing or damaged, the game can exit before a window even appears.
런타임 설치 후 실행되면 해결입니다. 그래도 바로 꺼지면 보안 프로그램: If the game launches after installing the runtimes, the problem is solved. If it still closes immediately, check whether security software is blocking it.
Microsoft 공식 사이트에서 최신 Visual C++ 재배포 패키지: Download and install the latest Visual C++ Redistributable (both x64 and x86) from Microsoft's official site. If it is already installed, choose Repair in the installer.
오래된 게임이면 Microsoft의 DirectX 최종 사용자 런타임을: For older games, install Microsoft's DirectX End-User Runtime. This covers errors about missing files such as d3dx9_43.dll.
게임 안내에 .NET이 필요하다고 되어 있으면 해당 버전의 .NET 런타: If the game says it needs .NET, install that version of the .NET runtime, and if the game folder has a _CommonRedist or Redist folder with installers, run those as well.
Do not use sites that offer individual DLL files for download.
Windows 보안 보호 기록에서 차단 확인하고 예외 추가하기: Check Windows Security protection history for blocks and add an exclusion
백신이 게임 실행 파일이나 안티치트 드라이버를 위협으로 오인하면 실행 직: If antivirus mistakes the game executable or anti-cheat driver for a threat, it blocks it right after launch. Ransomware protection can also block writes to save files in the Documents folder and stop the game during startup.
예외를 추가한 뒤 실행되면 해결입니다. 격리된 파일이 있었다면 파일 검사: If the game launches after adding the exclusion, the problem is solved. If files were quarantined, you may need to restore them with a file check. If there is no block record, check permissions and the install path.
Windows 보안 → 바이러스 및 위협 방지 → 보호 기록에서 실행 시: In Windows Security → Virus & threat protection → Protection history, look for records of game files being quarantined or blocked at the time of launch.
정식 경로로 설치한 게임이 확실하면 바이러스 및 위협 방지 설정 → 설정: If you are sure the game was installed from an official source, add the game folder in Virus & threat protection settings → Manage settings → Exclusions → Add or remove exclusions. For third-party antivirus, use that program's exclusion menu.
랜섬웨어 방지 → 제어된 폴더 액세스가 켜져 있으면 제어된 폴더 액세스를: If Ransomware protection → Controlled folder access is on, add the game executable under Allow an app through Controlled folder access.
안티치트 오류가 나오면 게임 폴더나 런처의 안티치트 설치·복구 기능(예:: If you get an anti-cheat error, reinstall it with the anti-cheat install or repair function in the game folder or launcher (for example the EasyAntiCheat setup file).
게임 파일 검사와 관리자 권한·설치 경로 확인하기: Verify game files and check admin rights and the install path
손상되거나 격리된 게임 파일, 쓰기 권한이 없는 설치 폴더, 한글이나 특: Damaged or quarantined game files, an install folder without write permission, and paths containing Korean or special characters make some games close right after launch.
If the game launches after the file check, running as administrator or changing the path, keep that approach. If none of it works, contact the game's support with the faulting module name from step 1.
Steam은 라이브러리 → 게임 오른쪽 클릭 → 속성 → 설치된 파일 →: In Steam, go to Library → right-click the game → Properties → Installed Files → Verify integrity of game files; in other launchers, run the repair or verify function.
런처와 게임 실행 파일을 오른쪽 클릭해 관리자 권한으로 실행해 보고, 되: Right-click the launcher and game executable and choose Run as administrator; if that works, narrow the cause down to permissions.
설치 경로나 Windows 사용자 이름에 한글·공백·특수 문자가 있으면,: If the install path or Windows user name contains Korean, spaces or special characters, reinstall to an English-only path (for example D:\Games) or move the game with the launcher's move function and compare.
C:\\Program Files 아래 폴더에 저장 파일을 쓰는 오래된 게: Older games that write save files to a folder under C:\Program Files may stop having permission problems when installed on a different drive.
이벤트 뷰어에서 Kernel-Power 41 기록 확인하기: Check Event Viewer for Kernel-Power 41 records
게임 중 전원이 그냥 꺼지면 오류 창이 남지 않습니다. 대신 Window: When the power simply cuts out during a game, no error window is left behind. Windows often records a Kernel-Power 41 event, meaning it restarted without a clean shutdown, along with warnings just before it.
Kernel-Power 41만 있고 블루스크린 기록이 없으면 전원이 갑자: If there is only Kernel-Power 41 and no blue screen record, the power was most likely cut suddenly, so move on to the power checks in the next step. If there is a blue screen code, look into that code first.
Win + R에 eventvwr.msc를 입력하고 Windows 로그 →: Press Win + R, enter eventvwr.msc and open Windows Logs → System.
오른쪽의 현재 로그 필터링에서 이벤트 ID 41을 입력해 꺼진 시각과 같: Use Filter Current Log on the right, enter event ID 41, and find the Kernel-Power entry matching the time it shut off.
바로 앞에 WHEA-Logger 경고나 디스플레이 드라이버 오류가 있는지: Also check whether a WHEA-Logger warning or display driver error appears just before it.
전원 케이블·멀티탭을 빼고 벽 콘센트에 직결하기: Bypass the power strip and plug straight into a wall outlet
게임 중에는 순간 전력이 크게 늘어 멀티탭 과부하 차단이나 헐거운 전원: Power draw spikes during games, which easily exposes a power strip's overload cutoff or a loose power cable.
If it stops shutting off when plugged in directly, the power strip or cable was likely the cause. If it still shuts off, check the power supply's capacity and the PCIe power connections.
PC 전원 케이블을 멀티탭에서 빼 벽 콘센트에 직접 꽂고, 같은 콘센트에: Unplug the PC's power cable from the power strip and plug it directly into a wall outlet, making sure no high-power devices such as heaters or microwaves share that outlet.
파워서플라이 뒤쪽 전원 케이블이 끝까지 들어가 있는지 확인하고, 가능하면: Make sure the power cable is fully seated at the back of the power supply, and try a different power cable if you can.
UPS를 쓰고 있다면 UPS 용량이 게임 중 소비 전력을 감당하는지 확인: If you use a UPS, check that its capacity can handle the power draw during games, and temporarily take it out of the chain to compare.
파워서플라이 용량과 그래픽카드 보조전원 연결 확인하기: Check power supply capacity and graphics card power connections
그래픽카드는 게임 중 순간적으로 정격보다 높은 전력을 쓰기도 합니다. 파: Graphics cards can briefly draw more than their rated power during games. If the power supply is borderline or the card's power connectors share a single split cable, the PSU's protection circuit can cut power.
전력 제한을 낮췄을 때 꺼지지 않으면 파워 용량이나 노후 가능성이 커 더: If it no longer shuts off with a lower power limit, insufficient or aging PSU capacity is likely, so consider a higher-wattage power supply. If it still shuts off, check temperatures.
파워서플라이 옆면 라벨의 정격 출력(W)과 그래픽카드 제조사가 안내하는: Compare the rated output (W) on the power supply's side label with the recommended PSU wattage from the graphics card maker.
PC 전원을 끄고 플러그를 뽑은 뒤, 그래픽카드 보조전원 단자가 끝까지: Turn off the PC and unplug it, then check that the graphics card's power connectors are fully seated. If the card has two or three connectors, use a separate cable from the PSU for each instead of one split cable.
진단용으로 GPU 제조사 도구나 MSI Afterburner에서 전력 제: As a diagnostic, lower the power limit to 70-80% in the GPU maker's tool or MSI Afterburner and play the same game.
CPU·GPU 온도와 쿨러·먼지 상태 점검하기: Check CPU and GPU temperatures and the cooler and dust
CPU나 GPU가 한계 온도에 닿으면 부품을 보호하려고 전원이 꺼질 수: When the CPU or GPU hits its temperature limit, the system may power off to protect the parts. A loose cooler, dried thermal paste or dust buildup shows up only under loads like gaming.
청소·쿨러 점검 뒤 온도가 내려가고 꺼지지 않으면 해결입니다. 온도가 정: If temperatures drop and it stops shutting off after cleaning and checking the cooler, the problem is solved. If temperatures are normal and it still shuts off, a failing power supply is likely, so compare with another PSU or have it checked.
HWiNFO 같은 모니터링 도구를 켜 두고 게임을 해서 꺼지기 직전 CP: Run a monitoring tool such as HWiNFO while gaming and record the peak CPU and GPU temperatures just before the shutdown. Using its logging feature lets you check them after it shuts off.
CPU가 90°C 이상, GPU가 제조사 한계에 가까우면 PC 전원을 끄: If the CPU is at 90°C or higher or the GPU is near its maker's limit, power off, unplug the PC, and clean dust from the case fans and heatsinks with an air blower.
CPU 쿨러가 흔들리거나 고정 나사가 풀려 있지 않은지 보고, 몇 년 지: Check that the CPU cooler does not wobble and its screws are not loose, and consider reapplying thermal paste on a PC several years old. If that is hard to do yourself or the PC is under warranty, take it to the store or a service center.
CPU·GPU 오버클럭이나 언더볼트를 썼다면 진단 중에는 기본값으로 되돌: If you overclocked or undervolted the CPU or GPU, return them to defaults while diagnosing.
외부 장치를 빼고 고급 옵션에서 최근 업데이트 제거하기: Unplug external devices and remove the latest update from Advanced options
자동 복구 화면이 반복돼도 고급 옵션으로는 들어갈 수 있습니다. 실패한: Even when the automatic repair screen keeps repeating, you can still get into Advanced options. If a failed update is the cause, removing it is the most direct way out of the loop.
업데이트를 뺀 뒤 Windows로 들어가면 바로 업데이트 일시 중지를 걸: If Windows starts after removing the update, pause updates right away. If there is no update to remove or the loop continues, try System Restore.
PC를 끄고 USB 메모리·외장하드·도킹 장치를 모두 뺀 뒤 다시 켭니다: Turn off the PC, unplug all USB drives, external drives and docking devices, then turn it back on.
자동 복구 화면에서 고급 옵션 → 문제 해결 → 고급 옵션 → 업데이트: On the automatic repair screen, go to Advanced options → Troubleshoot → Advanced options → Uninstall Updates.
최신 품질 업데이트 제거를 먼저 하고, 큰 버전 업그레이드 직후 생긴 문: Choose Uninstall latest quality update first; if the problem started right after a major version upgrade, choose Uninstall latest feature update instead.
고급 옵션의 시스템 복원으로 이전 상태 되돌리기: Roll back with System Restore in Advanced options
드라이버나 프로그램 설치 뒤 루프가 시작됐다면 그 전에 만들어진 복원 지: If the loop started after installing a driver or program, you can roll system files and the registry back to a restore point made before that. Personal files are not deleted.
복원 뒤 정상 부팅되면 그 사이에 설치한 드라이버·프로그램을 하나씩 다시: If it boots normally after the restore, recheck drivers and programs installed since then one at a time. If there is no restore point or it fails, repair the disk and boot files from Command Prompt.
고급 옵션 → 문제 해결 → 고급 옵션 → 시스템 복원을 선택하고 계정을: Choose Advanced options → Troubleshoot → Advanced options → System Restore and select your account.
문제가 시작되기 전 날짜의 복원 지점을 고르고, 영향을 받는 프로그램 검: Pick a restore point dated before the problem started, and use Scan for affected programs to see what will be removed.
Do not turn off the power during the restore. Connect the charger on a laptop.
명령 프롬프트에서 chkdsk·sfc·bcdboot 실행하기: Run chkdsk, sfc and bcdboot from Command Prompt
파일시스템 오류, 손상된 시스템 파일, 깨진 BCD는 자동 복구가 같은: File system errors, damaged system files and a broken BCD make automatic repair fail at the same point every time. From the WinRE Command Prompt you can fix them directly without starting Windows.
명령이 오류를 고쳤다고 나오고 다시 시작해 부팅되면 해결입니다. chkd: If the commands report fixing errors and the PC boots after restarting, the problem is solved. If chkdsk reports bad sectors or the commands cannot read the disk, check for a storage problem first.
고급 옵션 → 문제 해결 → 고급 옵션 → 명령 프롬프트를 엽니다. Wi: Open Advanced options → Troubleshoot → Advanced options → Command Prompt. In WinRE the Windows drive may not be C, so first find the drive with the Windows folder using dir C:\Windows and dir D:\Windows.
찾은 드라이브가 C라면 chkdsk C: /f를 실행합니다. 저장장치 이: If the drive you found is C, run chkdsk C: /f. If you suspect the drive is failing, move your data off first as in the next step before doing this.
이어서 sfc /scannow /offbootdir=C:\\ /offwi: Then run sfc /scannow /offbootdir=C:\ /offwindir=C:\Windows to check system files.
부팅 파일을 다시 만들려면 bcdboot C:\\Windows를 실행합니: To rebuild the boot files, run bcdboot C:\Windows. Replace the drive letter with the one you found earlier.
안전 모드로 들어가 최근 드라이버 제거하기: Boot into Safe Mode and remove recent drivers
그래픽·저장장치 컨트롤러·백신 드라이버가 부팅 중 멈추면 자동 복구가 반: If a graphics, storage controller or antivirus driver hangs during boot, automatic repair keeps repeating. Safe Mode does not load these drivers, so you can get in and remove them.
일반 모드로 부팅되면 제거한 드라이버나 프로그램이 원인이었을 가능성이 큽: If it boots in normal mode, the removed driver or program was likely the cause. If you cannot even get into Safe Mode, take care of the storage drive and data backup first.
고급 옵션 → 문제 해결 → 고급 옵션 → 시작 설정 → 다시 시작을 누: Choose Advanced options → Troubleshoot → Advanced options → Startup Settings → Restart, and when the list appears, press 4 or F4 for Safe Mode.
장치 관리자에서 루프 직전에 업데이트한 드라이버가 있으면 속성 → 드라이: In Device Manager, if a driver was updated right before the loop began, open Properties → Driver tab and choose Roll Back Driver, or uninstall the device.
최근 설치한 백신·디스크 암호화·튜닝 프로그램은 설정 → 앱 → 설치된: Uninstall recently installed antivirus, disk encryption or tuning programs in Settings → Apps → Installed apps, then restart in normal mode.
저장장치 상태 확인과 데이터 백업 후 초기화 결정하기: Check the storage drive and back up data before deciding on a reset
위 방법이 모두 실패하면 저장장치 불량이나 복구할 수 없는 손상일 수 있: If all of the above fails, the drive may be failing or the damage may be beyond repair. Getting your data off before a reset or reinstall prevents irreversible loss.
초기화나 재설치 뒤 정상 부팅되면 해결입니다. 새로 설치한 뒤에도 루프가: If it boots normally after the reset or reinstall, the problem is solved. If the loop returns even after a fresh install, have a service center check the storage drive and memory.
BIOS에서 시스템 드라이브가 정상적으로 보이는지 확인합니다. 보이지 않: Check in the BIOS that the system drive appears normally. If it is missing or only shows up sometimes, a drive or connection problem is likely.
중요한 파일은 디스크를 다른 PC에 연결하거나, 설치 USB로 부팅한 뒤: Copy important files by connecting the disk to another PC, or by booting from an installation USB, running notepad from Command Prompt and using its Open dialog to copy them to an external drive.
백업이 끝난 뒤에만 고급 옵션 → 이 PC 초기화(내 파일 유지)나 Wi: Only after the backup is done, consider Advanced options → Reset this PC (Keep my files) or reinstalling Windows. If the drive is confirmed faulty, install onto a new drive.
디스크 표시등을 보며 충분히 기다린 뒤 판단하기: Watch the disk activity light and wait long enough before deciding
자동 복구 준비 중에는 디스크 검사가 함께 진행될 수 있어 화면이 멈춘: While preparing automatic repair, a disk check may be running at the same time, so the PC can still be working even if the screen looks frozen. Turning it off too early restarts the check from the beginning.
기다린 뒤 복구 화면이나 Windows로 넘어가면 해결입니다. 그대로 멈: If it moves on to the recovery screen or Windows after waiting, the problem is solved. If it stays stuck, check external devices and the storage connection.
본체나 노트북의 디스크 표시등이 깜빡이는지 봅니다. 표시등이 없는 모델은: Check whether the disk activity light on the case or laptop is blinking. On models without a light, check whether the dot animation on screen keeps moving.
표시등이 깜빡이면 1시간 정도 기다립니다. 노트북은 충전기를 연결해 둡니: If the light is blinking, wait about an hour. Keep the charger connected on a laptop.
1시간이 지나도 화면이 그대로이고 표시등도 움직임이 없으면 전원 버튼을: If the screen is unchanged after an hour and the light shows no activity, hold the power button to turn it off.
외부 장치를 빼고 BIOS에서 저장장치 인식 확인하기: Unplug external devices and check drive detection in the BIOS
저장장치 응답이 늦거나 케이블이 헐거우면 복구 환경을 불러오는 단계에서: A slow-responding drive or loose cable can make the PC hang while loading the recovery environment. An external drive can also hijack the boot order.
장치를 빼거나 다시 꽂은 뒤 복구 화면으로 넘어가면 그 연결이 원인이었을: If it moves on to the recovery screen after unplugging or reseating, that connection was likely the cause. If the BIOS does not see the drive, look at data recovery and replacement first; if it does but still hangs, use an installation USB.
Unplug all USB drives, external drives, memory cards and docking devices, then power on again.
BIOS(UEFI)에 들어가 시스템 드라이브가 모델명으로 보이는지, 부팅: Enter the BIOS (UEFI) and check that the system drive appears by model name and that Windows Boot Manager is first in the boot order.
데스크톱에서 드라이브가 안 보이거나 가끔만 보이면, 전원 플러그를 뽑은: On a desktop, if the drive is missing or only appears sometimes, unplug the power cord and reseat the SATA data and power cables or the M.2 SSD.
Windows 설치 USB로 부팅해 '컴퓨터 복구'로 들어가기: Boot from a Windows installation USB and choose Repair your computer
디스크 안의 복구 환경 자체를 불러오지 못하면 그 화면에서 계속 멈춥니다: If the recovery environment on the disk itself cannot load, it stays stuck on that screen. An installation USB carries its own recovery environment, so you can use Advanced options without the disk's one.
고급 옵션이 열리면 다음 단계에서 업데이트 제거와 시스템 복원을 시도합니: Once Advanced options opens, try uninstalling updates and System Restore in the next step. If you cannot get in even from the USB, the memory or motherboard may need checking.
다른 PC에서 Microsoft 공식 사이트의 미디어 생성 도구로 8GB: On another PC, use the Media Creation Tool from Microsoft's official site to create installation media on a USB drive of 8GB or more. Existing files on the USB will be erased.
문제 PC에 USB를 꽂고 부팅 메뉴 키(F12·F11·Esc 등, 제조: Plug the USB into the problem PC and boot from it using the boot menu key (F12, F11, Esc, etc., depending on the manufacturer).
언어 선택 화면에서 다음을 누르고, 지금 설치 대신 왼쪽 아래의 컴퓨터: On the language screen click Next, then instead of Install now click Repair your computer at the bottom left and go to Troubleshoot → Advanced options.
USB 복구 환경에서 업데이트 제거·시스템 복원 시도하기: Try uninstalling updates and System Restore from the USB recovery environment
최근 업데이트나 드라이버가 부팅 과정을 멈추게 했다면 그 변경을 되돌려야: If a recent update or driver is what stops the boot process, that change has to be undone before the PC can get past the repair preparation stage.
Windows가 켜지면 업데이트 일시 중지를 걸고 저장장치 상태를 한 번: If Windows starts, pause updates and check the drive's health once. If both fail, check the disk from the USB Command Prompt.
고급 옵션 → 업데이트 제거에서 최신 품질 업데이트 제거를 먼저 실행합니: In Advanced options → Uninstall Updates, run Uninstall latest quality update first.
변화가 없으면 고급 옵션 → 시스템 복원에서 문제가 시작되기 전 복원 지: If nothing changes, pick a restore point from before the problem in Advanced options → System Restore.
각 작업 뒤에는 USB를 빼고 다시 시작해 디스크에서 부팅되는지 확인합니: After each action, remove the USB and restart to see whether the PC boots from the disk.
USB 명령 프롬프트에서 디스크 검사와 부팅 파일 다시 만들기: Check the disk and rebuild boot files from the USB Command Prompt
부팅 파일 손상이나 파일시스템 오류가 있으면 디스크 쪽 복구 환경이 계속: Damaged boot files or file system errors keep the disk's recovery environment stuck. A slow-responding drive often reveals itself at this stage too.
정상 부팅되면 해결입니다. chkdsk가 불량 섹터를 찾거나 SMART: If it boots normally, the problem is solved. If chkdsk finds bad sectors or there is a SMART warning, back up your data and consider replacing the drive. If everything checks out but it still hangs, consider reinstalling Windows after a backup.
고급 옵션 → 명령 프롬프트에서 dir C:\\Windows로 Windo: In Advanced options → Command Prompt, confirm the drive letter of Windows with dir C:\Windows. If it is not there, try D, then E.
chkdsk C: /f로 파일시스템을 검사합니다. 검사가 비정상적으로 오: Check the file system with chkdsk C: /f. If the check takes abnormally long or reports read errors, stop and move your data off first.
bcdboot C:\\Windows로 부팅 파일을 다시 만든 뒤 USB를: Rebuild the boot files with bcdboot C:\Windows, then remove the USB and restart.
SSD 제조사 진단이나 다른 PC에서 SMART 상태를 확인할 수 있으면: If you can check the SMART status with the SSD maker's diagnostics or on another PC, do that as well.
SD 카드·USB 메모리의 쓰기 잠금 스위치 확인하기: Check the write-lock switch on the SD card or USB drive
SD 카드와 일부 USB 메모리에는 물리적인 쓰기 잠금 스위치가 있습니다: SD cards and some USB drives have a physical write-lock switch. If it is in the lock position, writing is blocked regardless of Windows settings.
스위치를 풀고 저장되면 해결입니다. 스위치가 없거나 풀려 있는데도 쓰기: If you can save after releasing the switch, the problem is solved. If there is no switch, or it is released but the drive is still write-protected, check the diskpart attributes.
SD 카드 옆면의 작은 스위치가 LOCK 반대쪽(위쪽)으로 올라가 있는지: Check that the small switch on the side of the SD card is pushed up, away from LOCK. If you use a microSD card in an adapter, check the adapter's switch.
스위치가 헐거워 카드 리더에 넣을 때 밀리는 경우도 있으니, 다른 카드: A loose switch can slide when you insert the card into the reader, so compare with a different card reader or adapter too.
Check whether the USB drive has a lock switch on its body.
diskpart에서 디스크·볼륨의 읽기 전용 속성 확인하고 해제하기: Check and clear the read-only attribute on the disk and volume in diskpart
디스크나 볼륨에 읽기 전용 속성이 붙으면 탐색기에서는 이유 없이 '쓰기: When a disk or volume carries a read-only attribute, File Explorer just shows it as write-protected with no reason. diskpart lets you see the attribute and clear it directly.
속성을 지운 뒤 저장되면 해결입니다. 지워지지 않거나 다시 켜지면 정책·: If you can save after clearing the attribute, the problem is solved. If it will not clear or comes back, check the policy and registry settings. If the attribute was No from the start, look at steps 3 and 4.
관리자 명령 프롬프트에서 diskpart를 실행하고 list disk로: Run diskpart in an administrator Command Prompt and check disk numbers with list disk. Identify the target drive precisely by its size.
select disk 번호, attributes disk를 차례로 입력해: Enter select disk followed by the number, then attributes disk, and see whether Current Read-only State is Yes. If so, run attributes disk clear readonly.
list volume으로 해당 드라이브 문자의 볼륨 번호를 찾고 sele: Find the volume number for that drive letter with list volume, then run select volume followed by the number and attributes volume clear readonly.
번호를 잘못 고르면 다른 디스크가 바뀌니 select 전에 다시 확인하고: Choosing the wrong number changes a different disk, so double-check before select, and do not use the clean command, which erases data.
레지스트리 WriteProtect와 이동식 저장소 쓰기 거부 정책 확인하: Check the WriteProtect registry value and the removable storage deny-write policy
레지스트리의 WriteProtect 값이나 그룹 정책의 쓰기 거부 설정이: If the WriteProtect registry value or a deny-write group policy is on, every USB storage device plugged into this PC becomes read-only. If the drive works on other PCs, this is the likely cause.
값이나 정책을 바꾼 뒤 저장되면 해결입니다. 다른 PC에서도 읽기 전용이: If you can save after changing the value or policy, the problem is solved. If the drive is read-only on other PCs as well, the problem is with the drive rather than PC settings, so check its file system.
Win + R에 regedit를 입력하고 HKEY_LOCAL_MACHIN: Press Win + R, enter regedit and go to HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\StorageDevicePolicies. If the key does not exist, this setting does not apply.
WriteProtect 값이 1이면 0으로 바꾸고 PC를 다시 시작합니다: If WriteProtect is 1, change it to 0 and restart the PC. Before editing the registry, back it up with File → Export.
Pro 이상 버전은 gpedit.msc → 컴퓨터 구성 → 관리 템플릿: On Pro or higher editions, open gpedit.msc → Computer Configuration → Administrative Templates → System → Removable Storage Access and check whether Removable Disks: Deny write access is Enabled.
회사 PC라면 보안 정책으로 일부러 막아 둔 것일 수 있으니 직접 바꾸지: On a company PC this may be blocked on purpose by security policy, so ask your IT staff instead of changing it yourself.
백업 후 파일시스템 오류 검사하기: Back up, then check for file system errors
안전하게 제거하지 않고 뽑거나 정전이 나면 파일시스템이 손상돼 Windo: Unplugging without safe removal or a power cut can damage the file system so that Windows blocks writes. Repair tools change the file system, so copy your files first while they can still be read.
검사 후 쓰기가 되면 앞으로는 안전하게 제거 후 뽑습니다. 검사가 실패하: If writing works after the check, use safe removal before unplugging from now on. If the check fails or the drive stays write-protected after all the earlier steps, suspect the drive's own protection state.
First copy the important files on the drive to the PC or another storage device.
탐색기에서 드라이브를 오른쪽 클릭 → 속성 → 도구 → 오류 검사의 검사: In File Explorer, right-click the drive → Properties → Tools → Error checking → Check, or run chkdsk E: /f in an administrator Command Prompt (E being the drive letter).
특정 파일만 수정되지 않으면 파일 속성의 읽기 전용 체크가 되어 있는지: If only certain files cannot be modified, check whether Read-only is ticked in those files' properties.
드라이브가 스스로 쓰기 보호로 잠겼는지 확인하기: Check whether the drive has locked itself into write protection
수명이 다한 USB 메모리·SD 카드나 오류가 많이 쌓인 SSD는 데이터: A worn-out USB drive or SD card, or an SSD with many accumulated errors, may have its controller switch itself to read-only to protect the data. This state often cannot be undone through settings.
다른 PC에서도 읽기 전용이고 상태 경고가 있으면 교체가 맞습니다. 보증: If it is read-only on other PCs too and shows health warnings, replacing it is the right call. If it is under warranty, ask the manufacturer about an exchange.
다른 PC에 꽂아도 읽기 전용인지 확인합니다. 어디서나 같으면 드라이브: Check whether the drive is read-only on another PC too. If it is the same everywhere, the drive's own state is the likely cause.
SSD는 제조사 도구나 CrystalDiskInfo로 상태와 남은 수명,: For an SSD, check its health, remaining life and warnings with the manufacturer's tool or CrystalDiskInfo.
읽기는 되는 동안 파일을 모두 다른 저장장치로 옮기고, 드라이브는 새것으: While it can still be read, move all files to another storage device and replace the drive with a new one. Repeated formatting can lose even the remaining data.
SSD가 보이는 동안 중요한 데이터 먼저 백업하기: Back up important data while the SSD is still visible
부하 중 사라지는 SSD는 다음 재부팅에서 다시 나타나지 않을 수도 있습: An SSD that drops out under load may not come back after the next reboot. Troubleshooting tests add load, so finish the backup first.
백업이 끝나면 온도 측정으로 넘어갑니다. 복사 중에도 계속 사라지면 데이: Once the backup is done, move on to measuring temperatures. If it keeps disappearing even while copying, it is safer to contact a data recovery service or the manufacturer first.
재부팅 후 SSD가 보이면 게임이나 대용량 작업을 하지 말고 문서·사진처: When the SSD reappears after a reboot, avoid games and heavy tasks, and copy irreplaceable files such as documents and photos to another drive or the cloud first.
If it disappears again during copying, copy in smaller batches.
부하 중 NVMe 온도를 재고 방열 확보하기: Measure NVMe temperature under load and improve cooling
NVMe SSD는 부하가 이어지면 빠르게 뜨거워지고, 한계 온도를 넘으면: NVMe SSDs heat up quickly under sustained load, and past their temperature limit they throttle and may stop responding. A slot right under the graphics card traps heat especially easily.
방열 뒤 온도가 내려가고 사라지지 않으면 과열이 원인이었을 가능성이 큽니: If temperatures drop and the drive stops disappearing after improving cooling, overheating was likely the cause. If it disappears even at low temperatures, check the firmware and power management.
HWiNFO나 CrystalDiskInfo를 켜 둔 채 평소 사라지던 작: Keep HWiNFO or CrystalDiskInfo running, briefly repeat the task that usually makes the drive disappear, and record the SSD temperature. Above roughly 70°C, suspect overheating (check the spec sheet for your model's limit).
메인보드 M.2 방열판이 있으면 장착하고, 방열판 아래 써멀 패드의 보호: If the motherboard has an M.2 heatsink, install it, and make sure the protective film on its thermal pad has been removed.
방열판이 없으면 SSD용 방열판을 달거나 케이스 흡기 팬으로 M.2 주변: If there is no heatsink, add an SSD heatsink or use a case intake fan to move air across the M.2 area. Unplug the power cord before working inside.
SSD 펌웨어 업데이트하고 이벤트 기록 확인하기: Update the SSD firmware and check the event log
일부 NVMe 모델은 특정 펌웨어에서 부하 중 컨트롤러가 멈추는 문제가: Some NVMe models have known issues where the controller hangs under load on certain firmware, and fixed firmware is released for them. Event Viewer often records controller errors.
업데이트 뒤 사라지지 않으면 펌웨어 문제였을 가능성이 큽니다. 최신 펌웨: If it stops disappearing after the update, it was probably a firmware problem. If it still happens on the latest firmware, turn off PCIe power management and compare.
eventvwr.msc → Windows 로그 → 시스템에서 사라진 시각: In eventvwr.msc → Windows Logs → System, look for errors or warnings from the stornvme or disk source at the time the drive disappeared.
SSD 제조사 도구(Samsung Magician, WD Dashboar: Check for a firmware update in the SSD maker's tool (Samsung Magician, WD Dashboard, etc.), and apply it if the release notes mention stability fixes.
펌웨어 업데이트는 백업을 마친 뒤에 하고, 노트북은 충전기를 연결해 업데: Update the firmware only after the backup is done, and keep a laptop on the charger so power is not lost during the update.
PCIe 링크 상태 전원 관리·ASPM 끄고 비교하기: Turn off PCIe Link State Power Management and ASPM to compare
PCIe 절전 기능이 SSD를 저전력 상태로 보냈다가 제때 깨우지 못하면: If PCIe power saving puts the SSD into a low-power state and fails to wake it in time, the device can look as if it has vanished. Comparing with power saving off tells you whether power management is the problem.
절전을 끈 뒤 사라지지 않으면 그대로 유지합니다. 전력 소모가 조금 늘: If it stops disappearing with power saving off, keep it that way; power consumption may rise slightly. If it still disappears, check how the M.2 drive is seated and try another slot.
Win + R에 powercfg.cpl을 입력하고 설정 변경 → 고급 전: Press Win + R, enter powercfg.cpl, then go to Change plan settings → Change advanced power settings → PCI Express → Link State Power Management and set it to Off.
같은 화면의 하드 디스크 → 다음 시간 이후 하드 디스크 끄기를 0(사용: On the same screen, set Hard disk → Turn off hard disk after to 0 (Never).
BIOS에 ASPM이나 PCIe 절전 항목이 있으면 진단용으로 꺼 봅니다: If the BIOS has an ASPM or PCIe power saving option, turn it off for diagnosis. Menu names and locations vary by motherboard. The NVMe drive's own power saving (APST) is not in Windows' standard settings, so change it only if the SSD maker gives instructions.
M.2 재장착과 다른 슬롯에서 비교하기: Reseat the M.2 drive and compare in another slot
M.2 SSD가 슬롯에 비스듬히 꽂혔거나 고정 나사가 없으면 진동과 열팽: If the M.2 SSD sits at an angle in the slot or lacks its retaining screw, vibration and thermal expansion can break contact momentarily. The slot itself or its power delivery could also be at fault.
다른 슬롯에서 문제가 없으면 원래 슬롯 쪽 문제일 가능성이 큽니다. 어느: If there are no problems in the other slot, the original slot is the likely issue. If it disappears in every slot, the SSD itself is likely faulty, so consider a warranty exchange or replacement.
PC를 끄고 전원 플러그를 뽑은 뒤 전원 버튼을 몇 초 눌러 남은 전기를: Shut down the PC, unplug the power cord, then press the power button for a few seconds to drain residual power. Touch the metal case to discharge static before working.
SSD를 빼서 단자를 확인하고 비스듬한 각도로 끝까지 꽂은 뒤 눌러서 고: Remove the SSD, inspect the contacts, insert it fully at an angle, then press it down and secure it firmly with the screw or retention pin.
메인보드에 M.2 슬롯이 여러 개면 CPU에 연결된 다른 슬롯으로 옮겨: If the motherboard has several M.2 slots, move the drive to another CPU-connected slot to compare. Some slots share bandwidth with SATA ports or PCIe slots, so check the motherboard manual.
노트북이나 보증 기간 중인 PC는 직접 분해하지 말고 서비스센터에 맡깁니: For a laptop or a PC under warranty, do not open it yourself; take it to a service center.
되돌리기가 끝나면 업데이트 일시 중지로 반복 막기: Once the rollback finishes, pause updates to stop the repeat
Windows는 실패한 업데이트를 다시 내려받아 같은 설치·되돌리기를 반: Windows re-downloads a failed update and repeats the same install and rollback. Stopping the reinstall while you look for the cause is what breaks the loop.
일시 중지 뒤 재부팅 반복이 멈추면 다음 단계에서 실패 코드를 확인합니다: If the reboot loop stops after pausing, check the failure code in the next step. If you cannot reach Windows and it keeps repeating, go to the recovery environment in the last step.
'변경 내용을 되돌리는 중' 화면에서는 전원을 끄지 말고 바탕 화면이 나: Do not turn off the power on the Undoing changes screen; wait until the desktop appears.
Windows에 들어가면 설정 → Windows 업데이트에서 업데이트 일: Once in Windows, set Pause updates for at least one week in Settings → Windows Update. On Windows 10, it is Settings → Update & Security → Windows Update.
업데이트 기록과 SetupDiag로 실패 원인 확인하기: Find the cause of failure with update history and SetupDiag
실패 코드와 설치 로그에는 어떤 드라이버나 장치 때문에 되돌려졌는지가 남: The failure code and setup logs often show which driver or device caused the rollback. Reinstalling without knowing the cause just repeats the same result.
원인 드라이버나 장치가 나오면 다음 단계에서 그것부터 제거하거나 업데이트: If a cause driver or device turns up, remove or update it first in the next step. If there are no clues, work through external devices and antivirus in order.
설정 → Windows 업데이트 → 업데이트 기록에서 실패한 항목의 KB: In Settings → Windows Update → Update history, write down the KB number and error code of the failed item (for example 0x800f0922, 0xc1900101).
기능 업데이트(버전 업그레이드)가 실패했다면 Microsoft 공식 사이: If a feature update (version upgrade) failed, download SetupDiag from Microsoft's official site, run it, and check the cause driver or rule name in the results file created in the same folder.
0xc1900101로 시작하는 코드는 드라이버 호환 문제일 때가 많으니: Codes starting with 0xc1900101 are often driver compatibility problems, so do the next step first.
외장 장치를 빼고 호환되지 않는 드라이버·백신 정리하기: Unplug external devices and remove incompatible drivers and antivirus
업데이트는 설치 마지막 단계에서 드라이버를 옮기다 실패하면 전체를 되돌립: If an update fails while migrating drivers in its final stage, it rolls everything back. Old device drivers, third-party antivirus and virtual drive or VPN drivers are common culprits.
정리 뒤 일시 중지를 풀고 업데이트하면 설치가 끝나는지 봅니다. 끝나면: After cleaning up, resume updates and see whether the install completes. If it does, reinstall the antivirus and other software in their latest versions. If it rolls back at the same point again, check storage space and system files.
업데이트를 다시 시도하기 전에 USB 저장장치·외장하드·카드 리더·도킹: Before retrying the update, unplug all USB storage, external drives, card readers and docking devices.
설정 → 앱 → 설치된 앱에서 서드파티 백신, 가상 드라이브, 오래된 V: Uninstall third-party antivirus, virtual drive software and old VPN programs in Settings → Apps → Installed apps. If the antivirus maker offers a removal tool, use it.
장치 관리자에서 노란 느낌표 장치나 SetupDiag가 지목한 장치가 있: In Device Manager, update any device with a yellow exclamation mark or flagged by SetupDiag to the manufacturer's latest driver, or remove devices you no longer use.
여유 공간 확보와 구성 요소 저장소 복구하기: Free up space and repair the component store
업데이트 설치에는 임시 공간이 넉넉히 필요하고, Windows 구성 요소: Installing updates needs plenty of temporary space, and if the Windows component store is damaged, the install can proceed but fail at the finishing stage.
설치가 끝나면 해결입니다. 여전히 실패하면 Microsoft 공식 사이트: If the install completes, the problem is solved. If it still fails, try an upgrade that keeps personal files and apps using the Installation Assistant or Media Creation Tool from Microsoft's official site. Back up important files before running it.
설정 → 시스템 → 저장소에서 C 드라이브 여유 공간을 확인합니다. 기능: Check free space on the C drive in Settings → System → Storage. For feature updates, keeping at least 20GB free is safer.
Restart, resume updates and try the update again.
Windows에 못 들어가면 복구 환경에서 업데이트 제거하기: If you cannot reach Windows, remove the update from the recovery environment
되돌리기마저 끝나지 않고 재부팅만 반복되면 Windows 안에서 할 수: If even the rollback never finishes and the PC just keeps rebooting, there is nothing you can do from inside Windows. In the recovery environment you can remove the installed update or rebuild the boot configuration.
Windows로 들어가면 1단계처럼 업데이트를 일시 중지하고 2~4단계를: Once you reach Windows, pause updates as in step 1 and work through steps 2-4. If everything fails in the recovery environment too, back up your data and consider reinstalling Windows.
Windows 로고가 보일 때 전원 버튼을 길게 눌러 끄는 것을 2~3번: Holding the power button to turn the PC off when the Windows logo appears, two or three times in a row, brings up the automatic repair screen. Go to Advanced options → Troubleshoot → Advanced options.
업데이트 제거에서 최신 품질 업데이트 또는 최신 기능 업데이트 제거를 실: Under Uninstall Updates, run Uninstall latest quality update or Uninstall latest feature update; if that does not work, try System Restore.
부팅 구성이 깨진 것으로 보이면 명령 프롬프트에서 Windows 드라이브: If the boot configuration looks broken, confirm the Windows drive in Command Prompt and then run bcdboot C:\Windows.
멈춘 단계를 구분하고 강제 종료 전에 충분히 기다리기: Identify the stage where it stopped and wait long enough before forcing a shutdown
Large updates often sit at the same percentage for a long time during installation. Forcing the PC off on the Don't turn off your computer screen can corrupt the install and lead to boot problems.
기다린 뒤 설치가 끝나면 해결입니다. 다운로드 0%에서 멈춘 경우는 다음: If the install finishes after waiting, the problem is solved. If it is stuck at 0% downloading, go to the next step; if it keeps stalling during installation, reset the update cache.
설정 → Windows 업데이트 화면에서 다운로드 중 0%에 멈췄는지,: Determine whether it is stuck at 0% while downloading on the Settings → Windows Update screen, or at a percentage during installation or on the restart screen.
재시작 화면에서 멈췄다면 디스크 표시등이 깜빡이는지 보고, 깜빡이는 동안: If it is stuck on the restart screen, check whether the disk activity light is blinking, and while it blinks, wait about 1-2 hours. Connect the charger on a laptop.
2시간이 지나도 퍼센트와 표시등에 변화가 없을 때만 전원 버튼을 길게 눌: Only if neither the percentage nor the light has changed after 2 hours, hold the power button to turn it off. If it then fails to boot, use Uninstall Updates in WinRE.
다운로드 0%면 네트워크·종량제 연결·배달 최적화 확인하기: If the download is at 0%, check the network, metered connection and Delivery Optimization
다운로드가 시작조차 되지 않으면 업데이트 서버 연결이 막혔거나 종량제 연: If the download never even starts, the connection to the update servers may be blocked, or Windows may be holding off because the connection is set as metered.
다운로드가 진행되면 해결입니다. 네트워크가 정상인데도 0%에서 움직이지: If the download proceeds, the problem is solved. If the network is fine but it still does not move from 0%, reset the update cache.
설정 → 네트워크 및 인터넷 → Wi-Fi 또는 이더넷 → 연결된 네트워: In Settings → Network & internet → Wi-Fi or Ethernet → your connected network, turn off Metered connection if it is on.
Turn off any VPN and proxy for now, and check that other websites open normally.
설정 → Windows 업데이트 → 고급 옵션 → 전송 최적화에서 다른: In Settings → Windows Update → Advanced options → Delivery Optimization, turn off Allow downloads from other PCs and try again.
SoftwareDistribution 폴더를 초기화해 업데이트 캐시 비우: Reset the SoftwareDistribution folder to clear the update cache
받다 만 파일이나 손상된 업데이트 파일이 캐시에 남아 있으면 같은 퍼센트: Partially downloaded or damaged update files left in the cache make it stall at the same percentage every time. Emptying the cache folder makes Windows download everything cleanly from the start.
새로 받은 업데이트가 끝까지 설치되면 해결이고, 며칠 뒤 Software: If the freshly downloaded update installs all the way, the problem is solved, and you can delete the SoftwareDistribution.old folder after a few days. If it still stalls at the same point, check storage space and system files.
관리자 터미널에서 net stop wuauserv와 net stop bi: In an administrator terminal, run net stop wuauserv and then net stop bits to stop the update services.
ren C:\\Windows\\SoftwareDistribution So: Run ren C:\Windows\SoftwareDistribution SoftwareDistribution.old to rename the folder. Renaming instead of deleting lets you undo it if something goes wrong.
net start wuauserv와 net start bits로 서비스를: Restart the services with net start wuauserv and net start bits, then click Check for updates in Settings → Windows Update. Part of the update history shown on screen may appear empty.
저장 공간을 확보하고 시스템 파일 검사하기: Free up storage space and check system files
C 드라이브 공간이 부족하면 압축을 풀거나 설치할 자리가 없어 특정 퍼센: If the C drive is short on space, there is no room to extract or install, so it stalls at a certain percentage. Damaged system files can also block the install.
재시작 후 업데이트가 끝나면 해결입니다. 계속 멈추면 마지막 단계처럼 해: If the update completes after restarting, the problem is solved. If it keeps stalling, download and install that update manually as in the last step.
설정 → 시스템 → 저장소 → 임시 파일에서 다운로드 폴더를 제외한 항목: In Settings → System → Storage → Temporary files, delete items other than the Downloads folder to free at least 20GB on the C drive.
관리자 터미널에서 DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /R: Run DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth and then sfc /scannow in an administrator terminal. Let each command finish even if its progress seems stuck for a while.
Microsoft Update 카탈로그에서 해당 업데이트 직접 설치하기: Install the update manually from the Microsoft Update Catalog
Windows 업데이트 화면을 거치지 않고 설치 파일을 직접 받으면 다운: Downloading the installer directly, without going through the Windows Update screen, lets you skip problems in the download and cache stages.
직접 설치가 끝나면 해결입니다. 직접 설치도 같은 지점에서 실패하면 오류: If the manual install completes, the problem is solved. If it fails at the same point too, note the error code, check for known issues with that KB, and pause updates in the meantime.
업데이트 기록이나 Windows 업데이트 화면에서 멈춘 업데이트의 KB: Find the KB number of the stalled update in the update history or on the Windows Update screen.
Microsoft Update 카탈로그(catalog.update.mic: Search the Microsoft Update Catalog (catalog.update.microsoft.com) by KB number, then download and run the file that matches your Windows version and x64 or ARM64 architecture.
버전 업그레이드처럼 큰 기능 업데이트라면 Microsoft 공식 사이트의: For a large feature update such as a version upgrade, use the Installation Assistant from Microsoft's official site. Back up important files before running it.
충전기를 30분 이상 연결해 과방전에서 회복시키기: Leave the charger connected for 30 minutes or more to recover from deep discharge
배터리가 완전히 방전되면 충전기를 꽂아도 바로 켜지지 않고 표시등도 한동: When a battery is fully drained, the laptop may not turn on right away even with the charger plugged in, and the indicator light may stay off for a while, because the protection circuit restarts charging slowly.
표시등이 들어오고 켜지면 과방전이었을 가능성이 큽니다. 30분 뒤에도 표: If the light comes on and the laptop starts, deep discharge was likely the cause. If there is still no light at all after 30 minutes, do a hard reset and, if possible, compare with another charger of the same rating.
다른 기기로 콘센트가 정상인지 확인하고, 멀티탭 대신 벽 콘센트에 충전기: Check that the outlet works with another device, and plug the charger into a wall outlet instead of a power strip.
충전기 양쪽 연결을 끝까지 꽂고, USB-C 충전 모델은 노트북 출력 이: Push both ends of the charger in fully. For USB-C charging models, use a charger rated at or above the laptop's wattage, in the port marked for charging.
전원 버튼을 누르지 말고 30분 이상 그대로 둔 뒤 충전 표시등이 켜지는: Leave it alone for at least 30 minutes without pressing the power button, check whether the charging light comes on, then power on.
충전기를 빼고 전원 버튼을 길게 눌러 하드 리셋하기: Unplug the charger and hold the power button for a hard reset
EC(임베디드 컨트롤러)가 비정상 상태로 멈추면 전원 버튼 신호를 받지: If the EC (embedded controller) freezes in an abnormal state, it may not receive the power button signal, so nothing happens. Draining residual power makes the EC start over.
배터리 없이 충전기만으로 켜지면 배터리 쪽 문제일 가능성이 큽니다. 내장: If it turns on with just the charger and no battery, the battery is the likely problem. If a built-in battery model still does not respond, look for a battery reset pinhole.
Unplug the charger and all USB and docking devices.
분리형 배터리 모델은 배터리를 뺀 뒤, 전원 버튼을 15~30초 길게 누: On models with a removable battery, take the battery out, then hold the power button for 15-30 seconds.
분리형이면 배터리 없이 충전기만 연결해 켜 보고, 내장형이면 충전기를 다: With a removable battery, try powering on with only the charger and no battery; with a built-in battery, plug the charger back in and power on.
내장 배터리 모델은 배터리 리셋 핀홀 사용하기: Use the battery reset pinhole on built-in battery models
배터리를 뺄 수 없는 노트북 일부는 바닥에 배터리 연결을 잠시 끊는 리셋: Some laptops with non-removable batteries have a reset hole on the bottom that briefly disconnects the battery. It has a similar effect to removing the battery without opening the case.
If it turns on after the reset, the EC or battery protection state was likely the cause. If there is no pinhole or it still does not respond, check whether only the screen is off.
노트북 바닥에 배터리 그림이나 'Reset' 표시가 있는 작은 구멍이 있: Look for a small hole on the bottom of the laptop marked with a battery icon or Reset. Whether it exists and where varies by manufacturer and model, so check the manual.
충전기를 뺀 상태에서 펴진 클립으로 구멍 안 버튼을 제조사가 안내한 시간: With the charger unplugged, press the button inside the hole with a straightened paper clip for the time the manufacturer specifies (usually a few to several tens of seconds).
충전기를 다시 연결하고 전원 버튼을 누릅니다. 일부 모델은 리셋 직후 충: Reconnect the charger and press the power button. Some models only turn on after a reset once the charger is plugged in.
전원은 들어오는데 화면만 꺼진 것인지 구분하기: Tell whether the laptop is on but only the screen is dark
전원 LED나 키보드 불빛, 팬 소리가 있다면 노트북은 켜져 있고 화면: If there is a power LED, keyboard light or fan noise, the laptop is on and only the display may be the problem. In that case the checks shift from the power circuit to the display.
외부 모니터에는 나오면 내장 화면이나 화면 케이블 문제일 가능성이 커 화: If the external monitor shows a picture, the built-in screen or display cable is the likely problem, so have the screen checked. If there are no lights, no fan and no external output, move on to a power circuit check.
전원 버튼을 누른 뒤 전원 LED, Caps Lock 표시등, 키보드 백: After pressing the power button, check for a power LED, Caps Lock light, keyboard backlight, or fan noise or vibration.
반응이 있으면 HDMI나 USB-C로 외부 모니터를 연결하고, 화면이 안: If there is a response, connect an external monitor via HDMI or USB-C, and if nothing appears, press Win + P to change the display mode.
밝기 올리기 기능키를 여러 번 누르고, Win + Ctrl + Shift: Press the brightness-up key several times, and try Win + Ctrl + Shift + B to restart the graphics driver.
충전기·전원 회로 점검을 서비스센터에 맡기기: Have a service center check the charger and power circuit
다른 충전기로도, 리셋 후에도 아무 반응이 없으면 충전 단자, 전원 회로: If there is no response with a different charger or after a reset, the charging port, power circuit or motherboard may be at fault. From here on, disassembly and part replacement are often needed.
다른 충전기로 켜지면 원래 충전기를 교체합니다. 그래도 반응이 없으면 서: If it turns on with another charger, replace the original charger. If there is still no response, decide on charging port or motherboard repair based on the service center's diagnosis. Data can often be recovered by connecting the SSD to another PC.
같은 규격(전압·출력·단자)의 정품 충전기를 빌려 연결해 봅니다. 규격이: Borrow a genuine charger with the same specs (voltage, wattage and connector) and try it. Do not use a charger with different specs.
충전 단자가 헐겁거나 타는 냄새, 액체를 쏟은 이력이 있으면 더 켜려고: If the charging port is loose, there is a burning smell, or liquid was spilled on the laptop, stop trying to power it on and take it in for service right away.
보증 기간이면 직접 분해하지 말고 제조사 서비스센터에 맡기며, 저장장치의: If it is under warranty, do not open it yourself; take it to the manufacturer's service center and ask them to preserve the data on the drive.
장치를 뺀 뒤 부팅되면 하나씩 다시 연결해 원인 장치를 찾습니다. 그대로: If it boots with the devices removed, reconnect them one at a time to find the culprit. If nothing changes, check whether the drive appears in BIOS.
BIOS에 시스템 드라이브가 보이지 않으면 저장장치 진단 단계로 바로 넘: If the system drive does not appear in BIOS, go straight to the storage diagnostics step. If it appears but Windows still does not boot, run Startup Repair from WinRE.
시작 복구로 부팅되면 완료입니다. '시작 복구에서 PC를 복구할 수 없습: If Startup Repair gets the PC booting, you are done. If it reports that it couldn't repair your PC, rebuild the boot configuration from Command Prompt.
전원 버튼을 길게 눌러 강제로 끄고 다시 켜기를 2~3회 반복하면 자동: Hold the power button to force the PC off, then turn it back on. Repeating this 2–3 times brings up the Automatic Repair screen.
자동 복구 화면이 나오지 않으면 다른 PC에서 만든 Windows 설치: If Automatic Repair does not appear, boot from a Windows installation USB created on another PC and select "Repair your computer".
명령 프롬프트에서 부팅 구성 다시 만들기: Rebuild the boot configuration from Command Prompt
시작 복구로 해결되지 않으면 BCD(부팅 구성 데이터)나 부팅 레코드를: If Startup Repair does not fix it, you can rebuild the BCD (Boot Configuration Data) or boot records yourself.
다시 시작해 Windows가 열리면 완료입니다. diskpart에서 Wi: If Windows starts after a restart, you are done. If diskpart does not show a Windows volume or the commands fail, the storage device may be at fault, so move on to the RAM and drive diagnostics.
diskpart 를 실행하고 list volume 으로 Windows가: Run diskpart, use list volume to find the letter of the volume where Windows is installed, then leave with exit. In WinRE it may not be C:. Do not enter any command that selects, deletes, or formats a volume.
bcdboot C:\\Windows 를 실행해 부팅 파일을 다시 만듭니다: Run bcdboot C:\Windows to recreate the boot files. Replace C: with the Windows volume letter you found above.
레거시(MBR) 방식으로 설치된 PC라면 bootrec /fixmbr,: If the PC was installed in legacy (MBR) mode, run bootrec /fixmbr, bootrec /fixboot, and bootrec /rebuildbcd in that order.
WinRE에서 최근 업데이트를 제거하거나 안전 모드로 들어가기: Uninstall recent updates or enter Safe Mode from WinRE
업데이트나 드라이버 설치 직후 부팅이 안 된다면, Windows에 들어가: If the PC stopped booting right after an update or driver install, you can undo that change from WinRE without getting into Windows.
제거나 롤백 후 정상 부팅되면 같은 업데이트가 다시 설치되지 않는지 지켜: If the PC boots normally after the uninstall or rollback, watch that the same update does not reinstall. If you cannot even reach Safe Mode, diagnose the RAM and drive.
In WinRE, select Troubleshoot → Advanced options → Uninstall Updates.
월간 보안 업데이트 직후라면 '최신 품질 업데이트 제거', Windows: After a monthly security update, choose "Uninstall latest quality update"; after a Windows version upgrade, choose "Uninstall latest feature update".
새 드라이버를 설치한 직후라면 고급 옵션 → 시작 설정 → 다시 시작 후: If a new driver was just installed, go to Advanced options → Startup Settings → Restart, press 4 (Safe Mode), and roll back that driver in Device Manager.
진단에서 오류가 나오면 데이터를 백업한 뒤 해당 부품을 교체합니다. 오류: If the diagnostics find errors, back up your data and replace that part. If there are no errors but the PC still won't boot, back up your files and consider reinstalling Windows.
입력을 바꾼 뒤 화면이 나오면 해결입니다. 전원 LED가 켜져 있는데도: If the picture appears after switching the input, you are done. If the power LED is on but the screen stays black, check whether the monitor menu (OSD) appears.
모니터 메뉴(OSD)로 신호 문제와 패널 문제 구분하기: Use the monitor menu (OSD) to tell a signal problem from a panel problem
OSD 메뉴가 화면에 보이면 패널과 백라이트는 동작하고 있어 PC 신호: If the OSD menu shows on screen, the panel and backlight are working, so the problem is more likely on the PC signal side. If even the OSD is invisible, suspect the monitor itself first.
OSD가 보이고 설정을 바꿔도 검다면 케이블·포트·그래픽카드 쪽 단계로: If the OSD shows but the screen stays black after changing settings, move on to the cable, port, and graphics card steps. If the OSD does not appear at all, check the backlight in the next step.
With the PC and cable still connected, press the monitor's menu button to open the OSD.
If the menu appears, check that brightness and contrast have not been turned down to near 0.
절전(ECO)·자동 밝기·자동 전원 끄기 같은 기능이 화면을 꺼 두고 있: Make sure features such as power saving (ECO), auto brightness, or auto power-off are not keeping the screen dark, and turn them off for now.
손전등을 비춰 백라이트 고장 확인하기: Shine a flashlight on the screen to check for a backlight failure
백라이트가 꺼지면 화면은 그려지고 있어도 검게 보입니다. 빛을 비추면 희: When the backlight fails, the image is still being drawn but looks black. Shining a light can reveal a faint image, showing that the panel is still getting a signal.
희미한 화면이 보이면 모니터 수리를 검토합니다. 아무것도 보이지 않으면: If a faint image is visible, consider repairing the monitor. If nothing is visible, check the video cable and the PC side.
With the PC on, shine a phone flashlight at the screen from close up and at an angle.
바탕화면 아이콘이나 글자가 희미하게 보이면 백라이트나 모니터 전원부 고장: If desktop icons or text are faintly visible, the backlight or the monitor's power board has likely failed.
이 경우 PC 본체를 분해하지 말고 모니터 제조사 점검이나 수리를 먼저: In that case, do not open the PC; contact the monitor manufacturer for inspection or repair first.
다른 케이블로 화면이 나오면 기존 케이블을 교체합니다. 그대로면 다른 포: If another cable brings the picture back, replace the old cable. If nothing changes, compare with another port and another monitor.
다른 모니터에서는 화면이 나오면 기존 모니터 문제일 가능성이 큽니다. 어: If another monitor shows a picture, the original monitor is the likely problem. If no monitor shows anything, check the PC's graphics output.
진단 LED가 DRAM이나 VGA에서 멈추면 해당 부품의 장착 상태를 점: If the diagnostic LED stops at DRAM or VGA, check how that part is seated or send it for repair. If all LEDs pass but there is still no picture, check the output port and graphics driver.
작업 관리자도 깜빡이는지 보고 앱 문제와 구분하기: Check whether Task Manager also flickers to rule out an app problem
작업 관리자 창까지 깜빡이면 디스플레이 드라이버 쪽, 작업 관리자는 멀쩡: If even the Task Manager window flickers, the display driver is the likely cause; if Task Manager is fine and only other windows flicker, a particular app is more likely.
If Task Manager flickers too, check the graphics driver and display settings. If the flicker stops after closing a specific app, update or remove that app.
Ctrl + Shift + Esc로 작업 관리자를 연 채 잠시 화면을 지: Open Task Manager with Ctrl + Shift + Esc and watch the screen for a while.
작업 관리자는 깜빡이지 않는데 뒤쪽 화면만 깜빡이면, 그때 실행 중인 보: If Task Manager does not flicker but the windows behind it do, close the security, screen-recording, and overlay apps running at the time one by one.
종료했을 때 깜빡임이 멈추는 앱이 있으면 그 앱을 최신 버전으로 업데이트: If closing an app stops the flicker, update that app to the latest version or uninstall it.
권장 해상도와 지원 주사율로 바꾼 뒤 깜빡임이 멈추면 그 값을 유지합니다: If the flicker stops after switching to the recommended resolution and a supported refresh rate, keep those values. If not, check the cable and port.
케이블을 바꾸거나 직접 연결한 뒤 멈추면 기존 케이블·젠더가 원인일 수: If the flicker stops after changing the cable or connecting directly, the old cable or adapter may be the cause. If not, check the graphics driver.
드라이버를 바꾼 뒤 깜빡임이 사라지면 그 버전을 유지합니다. 그대로면 V: If the flicker disappears after changing the driver, keep that version. If not, compare VRR, HDR, overlays, and monitor settings.
특정 기능을 껐을 때 멈추면 그 기능은 꺼 둔 채 사용하고, 그래픽 드라: If turning off a particular feature stops it, keep that feature off and compare again when a new graphics driver or monitor firmware is released. If it still flickers with everything off, cross-test with another monitor.
모니터 OSD에서 절전(ECO)·오버드라이브·동적 명암 기능을 하나씩 끄: In the monitor's OSD, turn off power saving (ECO), overdrive, and dynamic contrast one at a time and compare.
깜빡임이 모니터를 따라가면 모니터 점검이나 수리를 검토하고, PC를 따라: If the flicker follows the monitor, consider having the monitor inspected or repaired; if it follows the PC, recheck the graphics card and driver.
HDMI 입력을 직접 고른 뒤 화면이 나오면 해결입니다. 그대로 '신호: If the picture appears after choosing the HDMI input manually, you are done. If it still says "No signal", reconnect the cable.
다른 케이블에서 화면이 나오면 기존 HDMI 케이블을 교체합니다. 그대로: If another cable works, replace the old HDMI cable. If not, check the PC's display output mode.
Win + P로 출력 모드 바꾸기: Change the display mode with Win + P
출력 모드가 'PC 화면만'으로 되어 있으면 HDMI로 연결해도 신호가: If the display mode is set to "PC screen only", no signal goes out over HDMI even when it is connected.
모드를 바꾼 뒤 화면이 나오면 원하는 모드로 두고 사용합니다. 어떤 모드: If the picture appears after changing modes, keep the mode you want. If it shows "No signal" in every mode, check the TV or monitor input settings.
Press Win + P and select Duplicate or Extend.
화면이 안 보여 메뉴를 고르기 어렵다면 Win 키를 누른 채 P를 한 번: If you cannot see the menu to choose, hold the Win key and press P once at a time to cycle the mode, waiting a few seconds after each change.
노트북은 Fn과 함께 누르는 화면 전환 키(모니터 아이콘, 위치는 제조사: On a laptop, also try the display-switch key pressed together with Fn (it has a monitor icon; its position varies by manufacturer).
설정 → 시스템 → 디스플레이 → 여러 디스플레이에서 감지를 눌러 연결된: Go to Settings → System → Display → Multiple displays and press Detect so Windows looks for the connected screen again.
TV의 HDMI 입력 번호와 HDMI 모드 확인하기: Check the TV's HDMI input number and HDMI mode
TV는 포트마다 입력 번호가 따로 있고, 고화질 신호용 HDMI 모드(U: TVs give each port its own input number, and if the high-bandwidth HDMI mode (called UHD, Enhanced, and so on depending on the maker) does not match the PC's output, there may be no picture.
HDMI 모드를 바꾸거나 해상도를 낮춰 화면이 나오면 TV와 PC가 모두: If changing the HDMI mode or lowering the resolution brings a picture, set values that both the TV and PC support. If not, cross-test with another port and another screen.
TV 뒷면 포트에 적힌 번호(HDMI 1·HDMI 2 등)와 TV에서 고: Check that the number printed by the port on the back of the TV (HDMI 1, HDMI 2, etc.) matches the input selected on the TV.
TV 설정에서 해당 포트의 HDMI 모드나 입력 신호 확장 옵션을 켜거나: In the TV settings, turn that port's HDMI mode or input signal plus option on or off and compare.
PC가 4K·고주사율로 출력하고 있다면 1080p 60Hz 같은 낮은 설: If the PC is outputting 4K or a high refresh rate, first check whether a signal comes through at a lower setting such as 1080p 60Hz.
다른 포트나 다른 화면에서는 되면 처음 쓰던 포트나 화면 쪽 문제일 수: If it works on another port or another screen, the original port or screen may be the problem. If it works nowhere, check which graphics the HDMI port is connected to.
HDMI 포트가 어느 그래픽에 연결됐는지 확인하기: Check which graphics the HDMI port is wired to
데스크톱은 메인보드 HDMI와 그래픽카드 HDMI가 따로 있고, 노트북은: Desktops have separate HDMI ports on the motherboard and the graphics card, and on some laptops the HDMI port is wired to only the integrated or only the dedicated GPU.
올바른 포트나 GPU 모드에서 화면이 나오면 그 구성으로 사용합니다. 그: If the picture appears with the right port or GPU mode, keep using that setup. If it still fails, the HDMI port may be damaged, so have the manufacturer inspect it.
노트북은 제조사 사양이나 설명서에서 HDMI 포트가 어느 GPU에 연결됐: On a laptop, check the manufacturer's specs or manual to see which GPU the HDMI port is connected to, and make sure that GPU shows in Device Manager without errors.
제조사 앱에 GPU 모드(하이브리드·전용) 설정이 있으면 기본값으로 되돌: If the manufacturer's app has a GPU mode setting (hybrid or dedicated), set it back to the default and compare.
재부팅 후 이벤트 뷰어에서 꺼진 시점의 기록 확인하기: After rebooting, check Event Viewer for what was logged when the screen went out
화면이 꺼진 상태에서는 온도나 사용률을 볼 수 없으므로, 재부팅 뒤 남은: You cannot see temperatures or usage while the screen is off, so use the logs left after rebooting to judge whether it was a driver problem or a power cut.
Display 4101이 반복되면 드라이버와 오버클럭 단계를 먼저, Ke: If Display 4101 keeps appearing, start with the driver and overclocking steps; if only Kernel-Power 41 is logged, start with the power supply and auxiliary power steps.
PC를 다시 켠 뒤 Win + X → 이벤트 뷰어 → Windows 로그: After turning the PC back on, open Win + X → Event Viewer → Windows Logs → System.
화면이 꺼진 시각 근처에 Kernel-Power 41(예기치 않은 종료): Look near the time the screen went black for Kernel-Power 41 (unexpected shutdown) or Display 4101 (driver stopped responding and recovered).
게임 중·영상 시청 중·유휴 중 언제 꺼졌는지와 그때 실행한 프로그램을: Note whether it went out while gaming, watching video, or idle, and which programs were running at the time.
If the symptom goes away after the clean reinstall, keep that driver version. If it returns, check overclocking and power.
기본값에서 증상이 사라지면 오버클럭·언더볼트 설정이 불안정했던 것일 수: If the symptom disappears at default settings, the overclock or undervolt was probably unstable. If it still blacks out at defaults, check the power supply.
파워서플라이 용량과 보조전원 배선 확인하기: Check the power supply's capacity and the auxiliary power cabling
고부하에서 GPU 전력이 순간적으로 치솟으면 용량이 부족하거나 오래된 파: When GPU power spikes under heavy load, an undersized or aging power supply can sag in voltage, causing the screen to go black while the fans spin at full speed.
다른 파워나 분리 배선에서 증상이 사라지면 파워 교체를 검토합니다. 그대: If the symptom disappears with another power supply or separate cables, consider replacing the power supply. If not, check the auxiliary power connectors and how the GPU is seated.
파워서플라이 정격 출력(W)과 그래픽카드 제조사가 권장하는 파워 용량을: Compare the power supply's rated output (W) with the PSU capacity recommended by the graphics card manufacturer.
8핀 보조전원이 2개 이상이면 한 케이블에 달린 데이지 체인 커넥터 대신: If the card has two or more 8-pin power inputs, connect each with its own cable from the power supply instead of a daisy-chained connector on one cable.
파워가 오래됐거나 권장 용량에 못 미치면 여유 있는 정상 파워로 교차 테: If the power supply is old or below the recommended capacity, cross-test with a known-good unit that has headroom.
다시 연결한 뒤 증상이 멈추면 접촉 불량이었을 가능성이 큽니다. 커넥터가: If the symptom stops after reconnecting, a poor contact was the likely cause. If the connector is melted or the problem keeps happening, cross-test with integrated graphics or another GPU.
12VHPWR(12V-2x6) 커넥터는 틈 없이 끝까지 들어갔는지, 커넥: For a 12VHPWR (12V-2x6) connector, check that it is fully inserted with no gap and that the connector and pins are not melted or discolored; if anything looks wrong, stop using the PC.
증상이 기존 GPU를 따라가면 보증 수리나 교체를 진행합니다. 다른 GP: If the symptom follows the original GPU, proceed with warranty repair or replacement. If another GPU behaves the same, inspect the power supply and motherboard.
오류 문구와 이벤트 뷰어 Display 기록 확인하기: Record the error text and check Event Viewer for Display entries
DX12 튕김은 GPU가 응답하지 않아 드라이버가 재설정되는 경우가 많아: DX12 crashes often happen when the GPU stops responding and the driver resets, so the error text and system log help you judge first whether the driver side is involved.
DEVICE_HUNG이나 4101이 반복되면 드라이버와 GPU 안정성 단: If DEVICE_HUNG or 4101 keeps showing up, look at the driver and GPU stability steps first. If nothing is logged, start with the DX11 comparison and shader cache steps.
튕길 때 뜨는 DXGI_ERROR_DEVICE_HUNG·DXGI_ERRO: Take a photo or note of messages such as DXGI_ERROR_DEVICE_HUNG or DXGI_ERROR_DEVICE_REMOVED that appear when the game crashes.
이벤트 뷰어의 Windows 로그 → 시스템에서 튕긴 시각에 Displa: In Event Viewer under Windows Logs → System, check for a Display 4101 warning at the time of the crash.
4101이 함께 남아 있으면 GPU 드라이버가 제때 응답하지 못해 재설정: If a 4101 is logged as well, the GPU driver may have failed to respond in time and been reset (TDR).
DX11 또는 Vulkan 모드로 바꿔 같은 구간 비교하기: Switch to DX11 or Vulkan mode and replay the same section
같은 구간이 DX12에서만 튕기면 게임의 DX12 렌더러나 드라이버의 D: If the same section crashes only under DX12, a compatibility problem in the game's DX12 renderer or the driver's DX12 handling is likely.
DX11이나 Vulkan에서 정상이면 게임 패치나 드라이버 업데이트가 나: If DX11 or Vulkan works, use that mode until a game patch or driver update arrives. If every mode crashes, check the shader cache and game files.
게임 그래픽 설정이나 런처의 실행 옵션에서 DirectX 11 또는 Vu: Select DirectX 11 or Vulkan in the game's graphics settings or the launcher's launch options. Support and menu location vary by game.
Steam 게임 중에는 속성 → 시작 옵션에 -dx11 같은 인수를 넣는: Some Steam games use a launch argument such as -dx11 under Properties → Launch Options, so check the game's official guidance.
Replay the same section and see whether the crash goes away.
셰이더 캐시를 지우고 다시 만들기: Clear the shader cache and let it rebuild
손상된 셰이더 캐시는 DX12 게임에서 로딩 직후나 특정 장면에서 튕김을: A corrupted shader cache can make DX12 games crash right after loading or in specific scenes. After clearing it, the first few sessions may stutter while shaders are rebuilt.
캐시를 지운 뒤 같은 구간을 통과하면 해결입니다. 그래도 튕기면 게임 파: If you get through the same section after clearing the cache, you are done. If it still crashes, run the game file check and the driver steps.
Fully close the game and its launcher.
설정 → 시스템 → 저장소 → 임시 파일에서 DirectX 셰이더 캐시만: In Settings → System → Storage → Temporary files, select only DirectX Shader Cache and remove it.
NVIDIA는 %LOCALAPPDATA%\\NVIDIA\\DXCache,: For NVIDIA, delete the files in %LOCALAPPDATA%\NVIDIA\DXCache; for AMD, in %LOCALAPPDATA%\AMD\DxcCache. Folder names may differ by driver version.
검사로 파일이 복구되거나 모드를 뺀 뒤 정상이면 해결입니다. 그대로면 게: If the check repairs files or the game is fine without mods, you are done. If not, check the game and graphics driver versions.
특정 드라이버 버전에서만 튕기면 안정 버전을 유지하고 게임 패치를 기다립: If crashes happen only with a particular driver version, stay on a stable version and wait for a game patch. If it crashes on every version, turn off overlays and overclocking.
기본값에서 튕김이 사라지면 오버클럭이나 XMP/EXPO 설정을 낮춰 안정: If the crashes stop at default settings, lower the overclock or XMP/EXPO to find a stable setting. If it still crashes with 4101 at defaults, consider having the GPU itself checked.
테두리 없는 창 모드로 바꿔 비교하기: Switch to borderless windowed mode and compare
창 모드는 정상이고 전체화면에서만 깜빡이면 전체화면 전환 때 해상도·주사: If windowed mode is fine and only fullscreen flickers, the resolution and refresh-rate change during the switch to fullscreen is the likely cause.
테두리 없는 창에서 정상이면 그 모드로 쓰거나, 전체화면을 계속 쓰려면: If borderless windowed works, use that mode, or match the game's refresh rate in the next step if you want to keep fullscreen. If it still flickers, check VRR, HDR, and overlays.
게임 그래픽 설정에서 화면 모드를 '테두리 없는 창' 또는 '전체 창 모: In the game's graphics settings, change the display mode to "Borderless window" or "Windowed fullscreen".
Check whether the flicker disappears in the same scene.
게임 주사율을 모니터 주사율과 같게 맞추기: Match the game's refresh rate to the monitor's
게임 안 주사율이 Windows 설정과 다르면 전체화면에 들어갈 때마다: If the in-game refresh rate differs from the Windows setting, the monitor may switch modes and flicker every time the game goes fullscreen.
값을 맞춘 뒤 깜빡임이 멈추면 그대로 유지합니다. 그대로면 전체 화면 최: If the flicker stops after matching the values, keep them. If not, turn off fullscreen optimizations and compare.
설정 → 시스템 → 디스플레이 → 고급 디스플레이에서 현재 해상도와 주사: Check the current resolution and refresh rate in Settings → System → Display → Advanced display.
Set the resolution and refresh rate in the game's graphics settings to the same values.
전체 화면 최적화를 끄고 비교하기: Turn off fullscreen optimizations and compare
전체 화면 최적화는 일부 게임에서 전체화면과 창 모드 처리 방식이 섞이며: In some games, fullscreen optimizations mix fullscreen and windowed handling and can cause flicker or switching problems.
체크한 뒤 깜빡임이 사라지면 그 게임에만 설정을 유지합니다. 그대로면 V: If the flicker disappears with the box checked, keep the setting for that game only. If not, turn off VRR, HDR, and overlays one at a time.
Right-click the game's executable (.exe) and open Properties → Compatibility.
게임을 다시 실행해 비교하고, 차이가 없으면 체크를 해제해 원래대로 둡니: Relaunch the game to compare; if nothing changes, uncheck the box to restore the original setting.
특정 항목을 껐을 때 멈추면 그 게임에서는 꺼 두고, 드라이버나 게임 업: If turning off a particular item stops it, leave it off for that game and try turning it back on after a driver or game update. If it still flickers with everything off, check the graphics driver.
드라이버를 바꾼 뒤 전체화면 깜빡임이 사라지면 그 버전을 유지합니다. 그: If the fullscreen flicker disappears after changing the driver, keep that version. If not, cross-test with another monitor.
다른 모니터에서는 정상이면 기존 모니터의 VRR·주사율 처리 문제일 수: If another monitor is fine, the original monitor's VRR or refresh-rate handling may be the problem, so check its firmware or the manufacturer's guidance. If it happens everywhere, wait for a game patch.
항상 0x133이고 저장장치 사용이 많을 때 생기면 스토리지 드라이버와: If it is always 0x133 and happens during heavy disk activity, suspect the storage driver and SSD firmware first; if it happens while gaming or using the network, suspect those drivers first.
덤프 파일로 지연을 일으킨 드라이버 확인하기: Use the dump file to find the driver that caused the delay
0x133은 드라이버가 정해진 시간 안에 처리를 끝내지 못할 때 발생하므: 0x133 occurs when a driver fails to finish its work within the allowed time, so the driver name recorded in the dump is the most direct clue.
덤프가 가리키는 드라이버가 있으면 그 장치의 드라이버부터 롤백하거나 바꿉: If the dump points to a driver, roll back or replace that device's driver first. If there are no dump files, check that small memory dump is enabled under Startup and Recovery in System Properties.
C:\\Windows\\Minidump 폴더에 .dmp 파일이 생겼는지: Check whether .dmp files have been created in the C:\Windows\Minidump folder.
Microsoft Store에서 WinDbg를 설치하고 덤프 파일을 연: Install WinDbg from the Microsoft Store, open the dump file, and run !analyze -v.
결과의 MODULE_NAME·IMAGE_NAME에 나온 .sys 파일이: Identify which device driver the .sys file shown in MODULE_NAME or IMAGE_NAME belongs to. Examples: storahci.sys, iaStorA.sys, nvlddmkm.sys
되돌린 뒤 블루스크린이 멈추면 해당 드라이버나 장치를 원인으로 보고 안정: If the blue screens stop after reverting, treat that driver or device as the cause and stay on a stable version. If not, check the SATA controller driver.
SATA AHCI 컨트롤러를 Windows 표준 드라이버로 바꾸기: Switch the SATA AHCI controller to the standard Windows driver
제조사 SATA 컨트롤러 드라이버(예: Intel RST의 iaStorA: DPC_WATCHDOG_VIOLATION is known to occur with some combinations of a vendor SATA controller driver (for example Intel RST's iaStorA.sys) and SSDs, so you can compare by switching to the built-in Windows driver (storahci.sys).
바꾼 뒤 블루스크린이 멈추면 표준 드라이버를 유지합니다. 부팅되지 않으면: If the blue screens stop after switching, keep the standard driver. If the PC will not boot, enter Safe Mode or System Restore from WinRE and revert to the original driver.
RAID 구성이나 Intel VMD가 켜진 PC는 컨트롤러 드라이버를 바: On PCs with RAID or Intel VMD enabled, changing the controller driver can stop Windows from booting, so skip this step and follow the manufacturer's guidance.
장치 관리자 → IDE ATA/ATAPI 컨트롤러에서 SATA AHCI: In Device Manager → IDE ATA/ATAPI controllers, right-click the SATA AHCI controller and select Update driver.
내 컴퓨터에서 드라이버 찾아보기 → 컴퓨터의 사용 가능한 드라이버 목록에: Choose Browse my computer for drivers → Let me pick from a list of available drivers on my computer.
'표준 SATA AHCI 컨트롤러'를 선택해 설치하고 PC를 다시 시작합: Select "Standard SATA AHCI Controller", install it, and restart the PC.
SSD 펌웨어 결함이 명령 처리 지연을 일으켜 0x133으로 이어지는 경: A defect in SSD firmware can delay command handling and lead to 0x133, and manufacturers sometimes release fixed firmware for it.
업데이트 뒤 같은 작업에서 블루스크린이 사라지는지 며칠 지켜봅니다. 계속: After updating, watch for a few days whether the blue screen still occurs during the same tasks. If it continues, check BIOS defaults and the chipset driver.
SSD 제조사 도구(Samsung Magician, WD Dashboar: Check the current firmware version with the SSD maker's tool (Samsung Magician, WD Dashboard, Crucial Storage Executive, etc.).
새 펌웨어가 있으면 중요한 파일을 먼저 백업하고, 노트북은 충전기를 연결: If newer firmware is available, back up important files first, and on a laptop keep the charger connected while updating.
Do not turn off the power or close the program during the update.
기본값이나 새 BIOS에서 블루스크린이 멈추면 그 상태를 유지합니다. 그: If the blue screens stop at defaults or with the new BIOS, keep that state. If they continue, disconnect or replace the device the dump points to and compare.
If File Explorer opens after the restart, it may have been a temporary process error. If it keeps happening, clear its history and change its start location.
탐색기 기록을 지우고 시작 위치를 '내 PC'로 바꾸기: Clear File Explorer history and set it to open to "This PC"
탐색기는 처음 열 때 홈(즐겨찾기·최근 파일) 목록을 불러오는데, 이 기: File Explorer loads the Home (Quick access and recent files) list when it opens, and if that history is corrupted or includes a disconnected network location, the window may fail to open or freeze.
이후 탐색기가 정상적으로 열리면 해결입니다. 그래도 열리지 않거나 바로: If File Explorer now opens normally, you are done. If it still does not open or closes immediately, check the context-menu extensions.
Win + R에서 control folders 를 입력해 폴더 옵션을 엽: Press Win + R, type control folders, and open Folder Options.
On the General tab, click Clear next to "Clear File Explorer history".
Change "Open File Explorer to" to "This PC" and click OK.
압축·클라우드 동기화·보안 프로그램이 탐색기에 넣은 쉘 확장이 충돌하면: If a shell extension added to File Explorer by a compression, cloud sync, or security program misbehaves, Explorer may close as soon as it opens or stop responding.
특정 프로그램을 끈 뒤 정상이면 그 프로그램을 업데이트하거나 다른 프로그: If Explorer works after disabling a particular program, update that program or replace it. If not, check whether a recent update is involved.
Check whether you recently installed any compression, cloud sync, or security programs.
Close or uninstall that program for now, then open File Explorer again.
ShellExView 같은 쉘 확장 관리 도구를 쓴다면 Microsoft: If you use a shell-extension manager such as ShellExView, disable only the non-Microsoft extensions to compare, and once you find the culprit, re-enable the rest.
최근 업데이트 직후라면 해당 업데이트 제거하기: If it started right after an update, uninstall that update
업데이트 뒤부터 탐색기가 열리지 않았다면 다른 업데이트를 더 설치하기보다: If File Explorer stopped opening after an update, removing the update that started it is a clearer test than installing more updates.
제거 후 탐색기가 열리면 그 업데이트가 원인이었을 가능성이 큽니다. 업데: If File Explorer opens after the removal, that update was likely the cause. If no update is involved or nothing changes, run the system file check.
설정 → Windows 업데이트 → 업데이트 기록에서 문제가 시작된 날짜: In Settings → Windows Update → Update history, find the updates installed on the day the problem started.
같은 화면 아래쪽의 업데이트 제거에서 해당 KB 업데이트를 제거하고 PC: Under Uninstall updates at the bottom of the same page, remove that KB update and restart the PC.
제거 후 정상이면 업데이트 일시 중지로 재설치를 잠시 막고, 수정 업데이: If things are normal after removal, use Pause updates to hold off reinstalling for a while, and install again once a fix is released.
검사 후 탐색기가 열리면 해결입니다. 손상을 복구하지 못했거나 그대로면: If File Explorer opens after the scan, you are done. If the damage could not be repaired or nothing changes, compare in a new user account.
새 계정에서 정상이면 기존 프로필의 설정이나 확장 문제일 수 있으니 파일: If the new account works, the old profile's settings or extensions may be at fault, so consider moving your files to the new account. If the new account has the same problem, consider a Windows repair install.
sfc가 '손상된 파일을 발견하여 복구했습니다'로 끝나면 다시 시작해 증: If sfc reports that it found corrupt files and repaired them, restart and check the symptom. If it says some files could not be repaired, check CBS.log.
SFC가 고치지 못한 파일을 CBS.log에서 확인하기: Find the files SFC could not fix in CBS.log
sfc가 일부 파일을 복구하지 못했다고 끝나면, 어떤 파일이 남았는지 로: When sfc ends by saying some files could not be repaired, you need the log to see which files remain before deciding the next step.
다시 검사했을 때 오류가 없으면 완료입니다. 같은 파일이 계속 남거나 D: If the rescan finds no errors, you are done. If the same files remain or DISM fails, run DISM with installation media as the source.
관리자 명령 프롬프트에서 findstr /c:\"[SR]\" %windi: In an administrator Command Prompt, run findstr /c:"[SR]" %windir%\Logs\CBS\CBS.log > "%userprofile%\Desktop\sfcdetails.txt".
바탕 화면에 생긴 sfcdetails.txt에서 Cannot repair: In the sfcdetails.txt file created on the desktop, look for file names marked Cannot repair.
DISM을 다시 실행한 뒤 sfc /scannow 를 한 번 더 실행해: Run DISM again, then run sfc /scannow once more and see whether the same files remain.
DISM이 실패하면 설치 미디어를 원본으로 지정하기: If DISM fails, point it at installation media as the source
DISM은 기본적으로 Windows 업데이트에서 원본 파일을 받는데, 업: By default DISM downloads source files from Windows Update, so if the update components are also damaged or there is no internet, it can fail with errors such as 0x800f081f (source files could not be found).
DISM이 완료되면 sfc /scannow 를 다시 실행합니다. 설치 미: When DISM completes, run sfc /scannow again. If it fails even with installation media, check the disk's health and then do a repair install.
현재 Windows와 같은 버전·언어의 ISO를 Microsoft 공식: Download an ISO of the same Windows version and language from Microsoft's official site and double-click it to mount it. The examples below assume it mounted as drive D:.
dism /Get-WimInfo /WimFile:D:\\sources\\: Use dism /Get-WimInfo /WimFile:D:\sources\install.wim to find the index number of your installed edition (Home, Pro, etc.). If the file is install.esd, change the file name in the path.
DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHeal: Run DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth /Source:wim:D:\sources\install.wim:1 /LimitAccess. Replace the trailing 1 with the index you found, and for an esd file use esd: instead of wim:.
디스크 오류나 SMART 경고가 있으면 복구보다 백업과 드라이브 교체를: If there are disk errors or SMART warnings, back up and replace the drive before trying repairs. If the disk is healthy but the corruption remains, do a repair install.
파일을 유지한 채 Windows 복구 설치하기: Repair-install Windows while keeping your files
SFC와 DISM으로도 고쳐지지 않으면 현재 위치 업그레이드로 시스템 파: If SFC and DISM cannot fix it, an in-place upgrade rewrites all the system files. You can choose to keep your personal files and apps.
If sfc /scannow finishes without errors after the repair install, you are done. If corruption comes back even after that, run storage or memory diagnostics.
First back up important files to an external drive or the cloud.
마운트한 ISO에서 setup.exe를 실행하고, 노트북은 충전기를 연결: Run setup.exe from the mounted ISO, and keep a laptop plugged into its charger.
Under "Choose what to keep", select keep personal files and apps, and continue.
Windows 11 최신 버전은 설정 → 시스템 → 복구의 'Window: On recent versions of Windows 11, you can do the same reinstall from Settings → System → Recovery → "Fix problems using Windows Update". If that option is missing, use the ISO method.
If the drive is detected on another port or cable, the original port or cable may be at fault. If not, check its power supply.
USB 허브나 연장선을 빼고 PC 포트에 직접 연결합니다. 데스크톱은 앞: Remove any USB hub or extension cable and plug directly into the PC. On a desktop, use a rear port instead of a front one.
USB-C 드라이브는 커넥터를 뒤집어 다시 꽂아 보고, 데이터 전송을 지: For a USB-C drive, try flipping the connector and plugging it in again, and make sure the cable supports data transfer.
외장 드라이브 전원 부족 해결하기: Fix insufficient power to the external drive
외장하드는 USB 포트 전력만으로 모터를 돌리기 때문에, 전원이 모자라면: External hard drives spin their motors on USB port power alone, so with too little power they may fail to spin up or keep connecting and disconnecting without being detected.
전원을 보강한 뒤 인식되면 앞으로도 같은 방식으로 연결합니다. 회전은 하: If the drive is detected once power is improved, keep connecting it the same way. If it spins but still does not appear, check Disk Management.
3.5인치 외장하드처럼 전원 어댑터가 있는 제품은 어댑터를 연결하고 드라: For drives with a power adapter, such as 3.5-inch external drives, connect the adapter and check that the drive's power light comes on.
2.5인치 외장하드가 회전음 없이 딸깍거리기만 하면 Y 케이블이나 별도: If a 2.5-inch external drive only clicks without spinning up, try connecting it through a Y cable or a USB hub with its own power supply.
Do not connect it to a USB port on a keyboard or monitor, or to an unpowered hub.
디스크 관리에서 드라이브 문자와 파일 시스템 확인하기: Check the drive letter and file system in Disk Management
Windows가 디스크는 찾았지만 드라이브 문자가 없거나 파일 시스템을: If Windows finds the disk but it has no drive letter or Windows cannot read its file system, nothing shows up in File Explorer.
문자를 지정해 열리면 해결입니다. 디스크 관리에 아예 보이지 않으면 장치: If the drive opens after assigning a letter, you are done. If it does not appear in Disk Management at all, check Device Manager for USB errors.
Win + X → 디스크 관리를 열고 외장 드라이브 용량과 같은 디스크가: Open Win + X → Disk Management and look for a disk with the same capacity as the external drive.
볼륨에 문자가 없으면 우클릭해 드라이브 문자 및 경로 변경 → 추가로 문: If the volume has no letter, right-click it and choose Change Drive Letter and Paths → Add to assign one.
파일 시스템이 RAW로 표시되거나 포맷하라는 창이 뜨면 누르지 말고, 기: If the file system shows as RAW or a window asks you to format, do not click it; if the drive holds data, consider recovery first.
'알 수 없는 USB 장치(장치 설명자 요청 실패)'나 코드 43이 보이: If you see "Unknown USB Device (Device Descriptor Request Failed)" or Code 43, Windows could not read the device's information properly.
다시 연결한 뒤 정상 장치로 잡히면 해결입니다. 코드 43이 계속되면 다: If the drive is detected as a normal device after reconnecting, you are done. If Code 43 persists, check the same drive on another PC.
Win + X → 장치 관리자에서 범용 직렬 버스 컨트롤러와 디스크 드라: In Win + X → Device Manager, expand Universal Serial Bus controllers and Disk drives and look for devices with an exclamation mark.
해당 장치를 우클릭해 디바이스 제거를 누르고, 드라이브를 뺐다가 다시 연: Right-click that device, choose Uninstall device, then unplug the drive and plug it back in.
제어판 전원 옵션의 고급 설정에서 USB 선택적 절전 모드 설정을 사용: In the advanced settings of Control Panel's Power Options, set USB selective suspend to Disabled and compare.
다른 PC에서는 인식되면 현재 PC의 USB 포트나 드라이버 쪽 문제일: If another PC detects the drive, the current PC's USB ports or drivers may be at fault. If no PC detects it, follow the step for protecting your data.
데이터가 중요하지 않다면 그 뒤에 초기화·포맷을 진행해도 됩니다. 중요한: If the data is not important, you can initialize or format the drive afterward. If it holds important data and no PC can read it, consult a professional recovery service first.
백업이 끝나면 검사가 반복되는 원인을 확인합니다. 백업 중에도 파일 복사: Once the backup is done, look into why the scan keeps repeating. If file copies often fail during the backup, check the drive's health first.
dirty bit가 남아 있는지 확인하기: Check whether the dirty bit is still set
부팅 때마다 검사가 뜨는 것은 보통 볼륨에 '검사 필요' 표시(dirty: A scan at every boot usually means the volume still carries a "needs checking" flag (the dirty bit).
