캐시를 비운 뒤 열리면 끝입니다. 공개 DNS에서만 주소가 나오면 다음: If it opens after clearing the cache, you are done. If only public DNS returns an address, change the DNS server in the next step. If neither does, the domain may be the problem, so tell the operator.
Chrome·Edge 주소창에 chrome://net-internals/: Type chrome://net-internals/#dns or edge://net-internals/#dns in the Chrome or Edge address bar and click Clear host cache.
nslookup 도메인과 nslookup 도메인 8.8.8.8을 각각 실: Run nslookup domain and nslookup domain 8.8.8.8 to compare whether your current DNS or public DNS returns an address.
Windows DNS 서버 또는 브라우저 보안 DNS 바꾸기: Change the Windows DNS server or the browser's secure DNS
The router's or ISP's DNS sometimes fails to answer for specific domains. If the browser has its own secure DNS configured, it can behave differently from Windows settings.
바꾼 뒤 열리면 그 설정을 유지하고 공유기 DNS를 점검합니다. 회사 네: If it opens after the change, keep the setting and check the router's DNS. On a company network, do not change DNS yourself; ask the administrator.
개인 네트워크에서는 설정 → 네트워크 및 인터넷 → 사용 중인 연결 →: On a personal network, go to Settings → Network & internet → your active connection → Hardware properties → DNS server assignment Edit, choose Manual, and enter 8.8.8.8 and 1.1.1.1.
Chrome은 설정 → 개인정보 보호 및 보안 → 보안 → 보안 DNS: In Chrome, check the current provider under Settings → Privacy and security → Security → Use secure DNS, and switch to another provider or briefly turn it off to compare.
사용하지 않는 네트워크 어댑터 끄기: Turn off network adapters you do not use
유선과 Wi-Fi를 동시에 쓰거나 가상 머신·VPN용 가상 어댑터가 켜졌: When wired and Wi-Fi are used at the same time, or virtual adapters for virtual machines or VPNs switch on and off, Windows changes the default route and browser requests get cut.
어댑터를 하나만 남긴 뒤 오류가 멈추면 그대로 둡니다. 계속되면 다음 단: If the error stops with only one adapter left, keep it that way. If it continues, check wireless adapter power saving next.
설정 → 네트워크 및 인터넷 → 고급 네트워크 설정에서 지금 연결된 어댑: In Settings → Network & internet → Advanced network settings, check the list of connected adapters (Control Panel → Network Connections on Windows 10).
유선을 주로 쓴다면 Wi-Fi를, Wi-Fi만 쓴다면 연결되지 않은 이더: If you mainly use wired, disable Wi-Fi; if you use only Wi-Fi, disable the unused Ethernet adapter.
Hyper-V·VirtualBox·VMware 같은 가상 어댑터는 해당: For virtual adapters such as Hyper-V, VirtualBox, or VMware, compare with those programs closed when you are not using them.
무선 어댑터 절전과 로밍 끊김 확인하기: Check wireless adapter power saving and roaming drops
Windows가 전력을 아끼려고 무선 어댑터를 잠깐 끄거나, 메시 공유기: When Windows briefly turns off the wireless adapter to save power, or a mesh router moves the device to another node, that moment is treated as a network change.
끊김 기록과 오류 시각이 겹치면 무선 구간 문제로 보고 공유기 위치·대역: If disconnect records match the error times, treat it as a wireless issue and adjust the router's position or band, or compare with a wired connection. If there are no records, check VPN reconnects in the next step.
장치 관리자 → 네트워크 어댑터에서 무선 어댑터를 두 번 클릭 → 전원: In Device Manager → Network adapters, double-click the wireless adapter → Power Management tab, and uncheck 'Allow the computer to turn off this device to save power'.
메시 Wi-Fi나 중계기를 쓰는 환경이라면 PC를 한 공유기 가까이 두고: If you use mesh Wi-Fi or a range extender, keep the PC near one router, open the same page, and compare how often the error appears.
Win + R → eventvwr에서 응용 프로그램 및 서비스 로그 →: In Win + R → eventvwr, go to Applications and Services Logs → Microsoft → Windows → WLAN-AutoConfig → Operational and compare disconnect times with the error times.
VPN 자동 재연결과 연결 전환 설정 확인하기: Check VPN auto-reconnect and connection switching settings
VPN 앱이 연결을 확인하다가 터널을 다시 만들 때마다 가상 어댑터가 바: Each time a VPN app rebuilds its tunnel while checking the connection, the virtual adapter changes and page requests can be cut.
VPN을 끄거나 서버를 고정했을 때 멈추면 VPN 제공업체에 끊김 기록을: If it stops with the VPN off or the server fixed, ask the VPN provider about the disconnects. If it happened only once right after you deliberately switched networks, a refresh is enough.
VPN을 잠시 끊은 상태로 한동안 같은 사이트를 써 보고 오류가 사라지는: Use the same site for a while with the VPN disconnected and see whether the error goes away.
VPN 앱 설정에서 자동 서버 전환이나 프로토콜 자동 선택을 끄고 서버: In the VPN app's settings, turn off automatic server switching or automatic protocol selection and fix one server to compare.
문제 사이트의 쿠키·사이트 데이터만 삭제하기: Delete cookies and site data for the problem site only
오래된 로그인 쿠키가 새 인증 방식과 맞지 않으면 사이트가 로그인 페이지: If an old login cookie no longer matches the site's new sign-in method, the site can bounce between the login page and the original page. If Incognito works, this is likely the case.
다시 로그인해 최종 페이지에 도달하면 끝입니다. 시크릿 창에서도 반복되면: If you can sign in again and reach the final page, you are done. If Incognito also loops, check the date and extensions next.
Ctrl + Shift + N으로 시크릿 창을 열어 같은 주소에 접속해: Open an Incognito window with Ctrl + Shift + N and visit the same address.
시크릿 창이 정상이면 Chrome 주소창에 chrome://setting: If Incognito works, type chrome://settings/content/all in Chrome's address bar, search for the site name, and delete only that site's data with the trash icon. You will be signed out of that site.
로그인 서비스가 다른 도메인(예: 통합 로그인 주소)을 거친다면 그 도메: If sign-in goes through another domain (such as a single sign-on address), delete that domain's data the same way.
PC 날짜와 HTTPS 강제 확장 기능 확인하기: Check the PC date and HTTPS-forcing extensions
PC 시간이 크게 틀리면 로그인 쿠키가 바로 만료된 것으로 처리돼 로그인: If the PC clock is far off, login cookies are treated as expired immediately and sign-in can loop. Extensions that force HTTPS can clash with the site's own HTTP redirects.
확장 기능을 끈 뒤 정상이면 그 확장 기능에서 해당 사이트를 예외로 둡니: If it works with an extension off, add the site as an exception in that extension. If it also loops in other browsers and on other devices, the site's configuration is the problem, so tell the operator.
작업 표시줄 시계가 실제 날짜·시간과 같은지 보고, 다르면 설정 → 시간: Check that the taskbar clock matches the real date and time; if not, click Sync now in Settings → Time & language → Date & time.
chrome://extensions에서 HTTPS 강제, 광고 차단, 개: At chrome://extensions, turn off HTTPS-forcing, ad-blocking, and privacy extensions one at a time and reopen the same page.
사이트 운영자라면 HTTP·HTTPS 이동 규칙 점검하기: If you run the site, check its HTTP/HTTPS redirect rules
CDN은 HTTP로 원 서버에 접속하는데 원 서버가 다시 HTTPS로 보: If the CDN connects to the origin over HTTP while the origin redirects back to HTTPS, the redirect never ends. This is commonly reported with Cloudflare's Flexible SSL mode.
이동이 한 번에 최종 주소로 끝나면 정상입니다. 계속 반복되면 웹 서버·: It is fixed when the redirect ends at the final address in one hop. If it still loops, check that the web server and CMS site address settings (http vs https, with or without www) agree.
개발자 도구(F12) → 네트워크 탭에서 로그 보존을 켜고 페이지를 열어: Open Developer Tools (F12) → Network tab, turn on Preserve log, load the page, and check which addresses the Location values of the 301/302 responses bounce between.
Cloudflare를 쓴다면 SSL/TLS 암호화 모드가 Flexible: If you use Cloudflare, check whether the SSL/TLS encryption mode is Flexible; if the origin has a certificate, switch to Full (strict) and make sure it does not overlap with the origin's HTTPS-forcing rule.
주소와 포트, PC 날짜부터 확인하기: Check the address, port, and PC date first
HTTPS를 쓰지 않는 포트에 https로 접속하거나 PC 날짜가 크게: Connecting with https to a port that does not serve HTTPS, or having a badly wrong PC date, makes the secure connection negotiation fail from the start.
주소나 시간을 고친 뒤 연결되면 끝입니다. 여러 HTTPS 사이트가 이: If it connects after fixing the address or time, you are done. If several HTTPS sites fail only on this PC, compare security software and extensions in the next step.
주소에 :8080 같은 포트가 붙어 있다면 안내된 주소가 http인지 h: If the address includes a port such as :8080, check whether the given address is http or https and type it exactly.
작업 표시줄의 날짜·시간이 정확하지 않으면 설정 → 시간 및 언어 → 날: If the taskbar date and time are wrong, turn on 'Set time automatically' in Settings → Time & language → Date & time.
백신 HTTPS 검사·VPN·확장 기능을 빼고 비교하기: Compare without antivirus HTTPS scanning, VPN, and extensions
HTTPS 검사 기능은 브라우저와 서버 사이에서 보안 연결을 다시 만듭니: HTTPS scanning rebuilds the secure connection between the browser and the server. If it does not match the server's TLS setup, a protocol error can occur.
특정 기능을 껐을 때만 연결되면 그 프로그램에서 사이트를 예외로 두거나: If it connects only with a particular feature off, exclude the site in that program or update the program. If it fails with everything removed, compare browsers and networks next.
시크릿 창(확장 기능이 기본으로 꺼진 상태)에서 같은 사이트를 열어 봅니: Open the same site in an Incognito window, where extensions are off by default.
VPN을 끊고, 백신의 HTTPS 검사·웹 보호 기능을 잠시 끈 뒤 다시: Disconnect the VPN, briefly turn off the antivirus HTTPS scanning or web protection, try again, and turn it back on as soon as you finish checking.
Windows에서 제어판 → 인터넷 옵션 → 내용 탭 → SSL 상태 지: In Windows, go to Control Panel → Internet Options → Content tab → Clear SSL state, then restart the browser.
브라우저 업데이트 후 다른 네트워크와 비교하기: Update the browser, then compare with another network
오래된 브라우저는 서버가 요구하는 TLS 버전을 지원하지 않을 수 있고,: An outdated browser may not support the TLS version the server requires, and TLS inspection equipment on a company or school network can alter the connection and cause the error.
핫스팟에서는 되고 회사 네트워크에서만 실패하면 TLS 검사 설정을 관리자: If it works on the hotspot but fails only on the company network, ask the administrator about TLS inspection. If it fails on every network, the site's TLS setup may be at fault, so tell the operator. Do not switch to HTTP to enter login or payment details.
Chrome은 설정 → Chrome 정보, Edge는 설정 → Micro: Finish updating in Chrome under Settings → About Chrome, or in Edge under Settings → About Microsoft Edge, and relaunch.
Connect the PC to a phone hotspot and open the same site.
Windows 시간을 자동으로 맞추고 지금 동기화하기: Set Windows time automatically and sync now
인증서는 유효 기간이 정해져 있어 PC 날짜가 과거나 미래로 틀어지면 정: Certificates have a fixed validity period, so if the PC date is off into the past or future, even valid certificates look expired or not yet valid. If several sites show it, the PC clock is the likely cause.
시간을 맞춘 뒤 경고가 사라지면 끝입니다. 전원을 껐다 켤 때마다 시간이: If the warning disappears after fixing the time, you are done. If the time goes wrong again every time you power on, check the motherboard battery next. If the time is correct and it still appears, check the certificate's dates directly.
설정 → 시간 및 언어 → 날짜 및 시간에서 '자동으로 시간 설정'과 ': In Settings → Time & language → Date & time, turn on 'Set time automatically' and 'Set time zone automatically', and check that the time zone is correct.
같은 화면 추가 설정의 지금 동기화를 누르고(Windows 10은 시계: Click Sync now under Additional settings on the same screen (under Synchronize your clock on Windows 10), then restart the browser.
켤 때마다 시간이 틀어지면 메인보드 배터리 확인하기: If the time is wrong at every power-on, check the motherboard battery
메인보드의 CMOS 배터리(보통 CR2032)가 약하면 전원 코드를 뽑았: If the motherboard's CMOS battery (usually a CR2032) is weak, the clock resets when the power cord is unplugged, and the date can jump back years right after boot.
교체 뒤 시간이 유지되면 인증서 경고도 함께 사라질 가능성이 큽니다. 교: If the time holds after the replacement, the certificate warnings will likely go away too. BIOS settings may reset after the replacement, so check the boot order and similar settings.
PC를 완전히 끄고 전원 코드를 잠시 뺐다가 다시 켠 직후 날짜가 틀어지: Shut the PC down completely, unplug the power cord briefly, turn it back on, and check whether the date is wrong right after startup and also in the BIOS screen.
데스크톱이라면 전원 코드를 뽑고 메인보드의 동전형 배터리를 같은 규격으로: On a desktop, unplug the power cord and replace the motherboard's coin cell with the same type. On a laptop the battery is internal and may require disassembly, so use the maker's service.
인증서 유효 기간을 직접 보고 사이트 만료인지 판단하기: View the certificate's validity period to decide whether the site's certificate expired
PC 시간이 정확한데 한 사이트에서만 경고가 나면 사이트 인증서가 실제로: If the PC time is correct and only one site warns, the site's certificate may really have expired. The user cannot fix this; the operator must renew it.
만료일이 지났고 다른 기기도 같으면 운영자에게 알리고 로그인·결제는 하지: If the expiry date has passed and other devices agree, tell the operator and do not sign in or pay. If the dates are valid and only this PC warns, briefly turn off the antivirus HTTPS scanning to compare, then turn it back on.
경고 화면의 고급 또는 주소창 왼쪽 '주의 요함'을 눌러 인증서 정보를: Click Advanced on the warning page or 'Not secure' at the left of the address bar, open the certificate details, and compare the validity start and expiry dates with today's date.
Check whether other devices, such as a phone, show the same warning for the same site.
인증서 발급자를 보고 가로채는 주체가 있는지 확인하기: Look at the certificate issuer to see whether something is intercepting
공개 사이트인데 발급자 이름이 백신 회사, 회사 보안 장비, 공공 Wi-: If a public site's issuer shows an antivirus company, corporate security appliance, or public Wi-Fi provider, something in the middle is intercepting the connection and presenting its own certificate. The fix differs from a problem with the site itself.
발급자가 백신이면 다음 단계로 HTTPS 검사를 비교합니다. 발급자가 낯: If the issuer is your antivirus, compare HTTPS scanning in the next step. If the issuer is unfamiliar and this is not a company or school network, do not sign in on that network; switch to another one.
경고 화면에서 고급 또는 주소창의 '주의 요함'을 눌러 인증서를 열고 발: Click Advanced on the warning page or 'Not secure' in the address bar, open the certificate, and check the Issued to and Issued by names.
공공 Wi-Fi에 막 연결했다면 http로 시작하는 주소를 열어 로그인: If you just joined public Wi-Fi, open an address that starts with http and finish signing in on the login page first.
백신 HTTPS 검사와 Windows 루트 인증서 업데이트 확인하기: Check antivirus HTTPS scanning and Windows root certificate updates
백신을 다시 설치하거나 업데이트하다가 자체 루트 인증서 등록이 빠지면 모: If an antivirus reinstall or update fails to register its own root certificate, every HTTPS site can appear untrusted. A PC that has not been updated in a long time may also lack newer root certificates.
업데이트 뒤 공개 사이트가 정상으로 열리면 끝입니다. 회사 내부 사이트라: If public sites open normally after updating, you are done. For an internal company site, have the administrator check the certificate chain in the next step.
백신의 HTTPS 검사·웹 보호를 잠시 끄고 같은 사이트를 다시 연 뒤: Briefly turn off the antivirus HTTPS scanning or web protection, reopen the same site, and turn it back on as soon as you finish checking.
끈 상태에서만 열리면 백신을 최신 버전으로 업데이트하거나 제조사 안내에: If it opens only with that feature off, update the antivirus to the latest version or repair-install it following the vendor's instructions.
설정 → Windows 업데이트에서 업데이트를 모두 설치해 루트 인증서: Install all updates in Settings → Windows Update to bring the root certificate list up to date.
내부 사이트는 관리자에게 공식 루트 인증서 배포 요청하기: For internal sites, ask the administrator to deploy the official root certificate
회사나 학교가 자체 인증기관으로 발급한 인증서는 그 루트 인증서가 PC에: Certificates issued by a company's or school's own certificate authority are trusted only when its root certificate is deployed to the PC. Installing a root certificate of unknown origin yourself would let someone intercept all HTTPS traffic.
배포 후 경고 없이 열리면 끝입니다. 다른 직원 PC에서도 같으면 서버의: If it opens without a warning after deployment, you are done. If other employees' PCs show the same, the server may be missing its intermediate certificate chain, so ask the server owner to check the chain.
접속한 주소, 인증서의 발급자 이름, 오류 화면 캡처를 IT 담당자에게: Send the address you visited, the certificate's issuer name, and a screenshot of the error to your IT staff.
관리자가 회사 관리 도구로 루트 인증서를 배포하면 PC를 재시작하고 다시: Once the administrator deploys the root certificate with the company's management tools, restart the PC and connect again. Do not install root certificate files received from the web or by email unless it is the official procedure.
이벤트 뷰어에서 오류 모듈 이름 확인하기: Find the faulting module name in Event Viewer
0xC0000005 자체는 '잘못된 메모리 접근'이라는 결과만 알려 줍니: 0xC0000005 itself only reports the result: an invalid memory access. You need to know which file caused it to decide whether to look at the app, a plugin, a driver, or memory.
모듈이 앱이나 플러그인이면 다음 단계로 앱을 정리합니다. 그래픽 파일이면: If the module belongs to the app or a plugin, clean up the app in the next step. If it is a graphics file, clean-install the graphics driver. If it spans several apps, check memory in the last step.
Win + X → 이벤트 뷰어 → Windows 로그 → 응용 프로그램에: Open Win + X → Event Viewer → Windows Logs → Application and open the Application Error entry (Event ID 1000) at the time of the error.
Note the Faulting module name and the exception code 0xc0000005. Reliability Monitor (Win + R → perfmon /rel) shows the same records by date.
모듈이 앱 폴더나 플러그인 파일이면 앱 쪽, nvwgf2umx.dll·a: If the module is in the app folder or is a plugin file, suspect the app first; if it is a graphics file such as nvwgf2umx.dll or atidxx64.dll, suspect the driver; if it is something like ntdll.dll and the app changes each time, suspect memory first.
앱 업데이트 후 플러그인·모드 없이 실행하기: Update the app and run it without plugins or mods
한 앱에서만 같은 작업 때 종료된다면 앱 자체 결함이나 그 앱에 붙은 플: If only one app closes during the same task, a defect in the app itself or a plugin or mod attached to it likely touched invalid memory.
특정 플러그인에서 재현되면 그 플러그인을 업데이트하거나 제거합니다. 아무: If a specific plugin reproduces it, update or remove that plugin. If it happens with nothing loaded, repair-install the app; if it happens in several apps, go to the next step.
앱의 업데이트 메뉴나 제작사 사이트에서 최신 버전으로 올립니다. 게임은: Update to the latest version from the app's update menu or the publisher's site. For games, also run the launcher's file check.
플러그인·애드인·모드를 모두 끈 상태로 실행합니다. Office 앱은 W: Run with all plugins, add-ins, and mods off. Office apps can be opened in safe mode by adding /safe, for example winword /safe in Win + R.
If it works, turn them back on one by one to find the item that causes the crash.
여러 앱에서 나면 메모리 오버클럭 해제와 메모리 진단하기: If several apps crash, turn off memory overclocking and test memory
서로 관계없는 앱들이 무작위로 0xC0000005를 내면 메모리 데이터가: When unrelated apps randomly hit 0xC0000005, memory data may be getting corrupted. Memory overclock profiles such as XMP or EXPO are one common cause.
진단에서 오류가 나오거나 기본 속도에서 종료가 사라지면 메모리 쪽 가능성: If the test finds errors or the crashes stop at default speed, memory is the likely cause. Test the modules one at a time or have them checked. If both are fine, check system files with sfc /scannow.
작업을 저장하고 Win + R에 mdsched를 입력해 '지금 다시 시작: Save your work, type mdsched in Win + R, and choose 'Restart now and check for problems'. Wait for the test to finish after the restart.
BIOS에서 XMP·EXPO·DOCP를 켜 두었다면 끄고 기본 속도로 며: If XMP, EXPO, or DOCP is enabled in the BIOS, turn it off and use the PC at default speed for a few days to compare. Menu names and locations differ by motherboard maker.
Visual C++ 재배포 패키지를 x86·x64 모두 설치하기: Install the Visual C++ Redistributable for both x86 and x64
0xC000007B는 64비트 앱이 32비트 DLL을, 또는 그 반대를: 0xC000007B often appears when a 64-bit app loads a 32-bit DLL or vice versa. Even on 64-bit Windows, 32-bit apps use the x86 runtime, so you need both.
앱이 시작되면 끝입니다. 오래된 게임이라면 다음 단계로 DirectX 레: If the app starts, you are done. For an older game, install the legacy DirectX components in the next step; if it is still the same, check for DLLs you copied by hand.
Microsoft Learn의 '지원되는 최신 Visual C++ 재배포: Download both vc_redist.x64.exe and vc_redist.x86.exe from the 'Latest supported Visual C++ Redistributable downloads' page on Microsoft Learn.
두 파일을 차례로 실행합니다. 이미 설치돼 있다고 나오면 복구를 선택합니: Run both files in turn. If it says the package is already installed, choose Repair.
Restart the PC and run the app again.
직접 복사한 DLL을 되돌리고 앱을 복구 설치하기: Undo hand-copied DLLs and repair-install the app
DLL 다운로드 사이트에서 받은 파일을 앱 폴더나 System32·Sys: Putting files from DLL download sites into the app folder or System32/SysWOW64 easily causes an architecture mismatch and this error.
복구 후 앱이 시작되면 옮겨 둔 DLL은 쓰지 않습니다. 계속되면 다음: If the app starts after the repair, do not use the DLLs you moved. If it continues, check the DirectX and .NET components the app needs in the next step.
앱 설치 폴더에 직접 넣은 DLL이 있다면 지우지 말고 다른 폴더로 옮겨: If you put DLLs into the app's install folder yourself, move them to another folder rather than deleting them.
게임은 런처의 파일 검사(Steam은 게임 파일 무결성 확인), 일반 앱: Restore the original files with the launcher's file check for games (Verify integrity of game files on Steam), or Settings → Apps → Installed apps → the app → Modify or reinstall for other apps.
System32·SysWOW64에 DLL을 넣었다면 터미널(관리자)에서: If you put DLLs into System32 or SysWOW64, run sfc /scannow in Terminal (Admin) to restore the Windows files.
게임이 요구하는 DirectX·.NET 구성요소 설치하기: Install the DirectX and .NET components the game requires
오래된 게임은 DirectX 9 시절 보조 DLL이나 .NET Frame: Older games sometimes also need DirectX 9-era helper DLLs or an older .NET Framework. If the 32- or 64-bit files of these components are missing, the same code can appear.
설치 후 시작되면 끝입니다. 그래도 같다면 오류 시각의 이벤트 뷰어 기록: If it starts after installing, you are done. If not, send the Event Viewer entry at the error time and the game version to the developer.
게임 설치 폴더에 _CommonRedist나 Redist 폴더가 있으면: If the game folder has a _CommonRedist or Redist folder, run the DirectX and vcredist installers inside it.
폴더가 없으면 Microsoft 다운로드 센터의 DirectX End-U: If there is no such folder, run the DirectX End-User Runtime Web Installer (dxwebsetup.exe) from the Microsoft Download Center.
게임 요구사항에 .NET Framework 3.5가 있다면 Win + R: If the game lists .NET Framework 3.5, turn it on in Win + R → optionalfeatures.
Office라면 빠른 복구, 안 되면 온라인 복구 실행하기: For Office, run Quick Repair, then Online Repair if needed
Office 업데이트가 중간에 끊기면 구성요소 버전이 섞여 앱이 DLL: If an Office update is interrupted, component versions can get mixed and apps can stop at the DLL initialization stage. Microsoft recommends repairing Office in this case.
복구 후 여러 번 실행해도 정상이면 끝입니다. Office가 아니거나 복: If it starts normally several times after the repair, you are done. If it is not Office or the error persists after repair, check pending updates and startup programs in the next step.
Office 앱을 모두 닫고 설정 → 앱 → 설치된 앱에서 Microso: Close all Office apps, then in Settings → Apps → Installed apps click ... next to Microsoft 365 or Office → Modify (Apps & features → Modify on Windows 10).
Run Quick Repair first, then try opening an Office app.
그래도 같으면 온라인 복구를 실행합니다. 인터넷이 필요하고 시간이 더 걸: If it is still the same, run Online Repair. It needs the internet, takes longer, and downloads and reinstalls Office.
보류 중인 업데이트를 마치고 클린 부팅으로 비교하기: Finish pending updates and compare with a clean boot
재시작을 기다리는 업데이트가 있으면 일부 DLL이 교체 대기 상태로 남습: If an update is waiting for a restart, some DLLs remain pending replacement. Programs that start with Windows can also hook into the app and block initialization.
클린 부팅에서만 정상이면 서비스를 절반씩 켜며 충돌하는 프로그램을 찾습니: If it works only in a clean boot, enable services half at a time to find the conflicting program. If it also fails in a clean boot, check the app's dependencies and system files next.
설정 → Windows 업데이트에 '다시 시작 필요'가 있으면 작업을 저: If Settings → Windows Update shows that a restart is required, save your work and restart.
Win + R → msconfig → 서비스 탭에서 'Microsoft: In Win + R → msconfig → Services tab, check 'Hide all Microsoft services' and click Disable all, then disable the items in Task Manager → Startup apps and restart.
이 상태에서 앱을 실행해 보고, 확인이 끝나면 같은 화면에서 서비스와 시: Run the app in this state, and when you finish checking, re-enable the services and startup apps on the same screens.
게임·일반 앱은 런타임 복구와 파일 검사하기: For games and other apps, repair runtimes and check files
앱이 쓰는 Visual C++ 런타임이나 앱 자체 DLL이 손상돼도 초기: Initialization also fails if the Visual C++ runtime the app uses or the app's own DLLs are damaged. If several apps fail at once, Windows files should be checked too.
복구 후 정상이면 끝입니다. 한 앱만 계속 실패하면 오류 시각의 이벤트: If it works after the repair, you are done. If one app keeps failing, contact its publisher with the Event Viewer Application log entry from the error time.
게임은 런처의 파일 검사를, 일반 앱은 설치된 앱에서 수정·복구 또는 재: For games, run the launcher's file check; for other apps, use Modify/Repair or reinstall from Installed apps.
설치된 앱 목록의 Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022: Use Modify → Repair on each Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable (x86 and x64) in the Installed apps list.
여러 앱이 같은 코드로 실패하면 터미널(관리자)에서 DISM /Onlin: If several apps fail with the same code, run DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth and then sfc /scannow in Terminal (Admin).
0xC0000135는 필요한 DLL을 찾지 못했다는 뜻이라 어떤 DLL인: 0xC0000135 means a required DLL was not found, so the DLL's name tells you what to install. This is more accurate than installing several runtimes by guesswork.
DLL 이름이 확인되면 다음 단계에서 해당 런타임만 공식 경로로 설치합니: Once the DLL name is known, install only that runtime from the official source in the next step. If no name is shown, go by the publisher's requirements document.
오류 창이나 이벤트 뷰어 → Windows 로그 → 응용 프로그램에 나온: Note the DLL name shown in the error window or in Event Viewer → Windows Logs → Application, along with the app's system requirements.
mscoree.dll이면 .NET Framework, vcruntime·: If it is mscoree.dll, .NET Framework is likely needed; names starting with vcruntime or msvcp point to Visual C++; hostfxr.dll points to a modern .NET runtime.
필요한 .NET·Visual C++ 런타임을 공식 경로로 설치하기: Install the needed .NET or Visual C++ runtime from the official source
.NET Framework 3.5는 Windows 기능으로 켜고, .NE: .NET Framework 3.5 is turned on as a Windows feature, while modern runtimes such as .NET 6 or 8 and Visual C++ come from Microsoft's download pages. Other sources cannot guarantee the version or signature.
설치 후 앱이 시작되면 끝입니다. 런타임이 이미 있는데도 같은 메시지가: If the app starts after installing, you are done. If the runtime is already present and the message persists, check security quarantine and the app files next.
.NET Framework가 필요하면 Win + R → optionalf: If .NET Framework is needed, check .NET Framework 3.5 (includes .NET 2.0 and 3.0) in Win + R → optionalfeatures and click OK.
최신 .NET이 필요하면 Microsoft .NET 다운로드 페이지에서: If a modern .NET is needed, install the Desktop Runtime (x64 or x86) of the version the app requires from Microsoft's .NET download page.
Visual C++ DLL이라면 vc_redist.x64.exe와 vc_: For a Visual C++ DLL, install vc_redist.x64.exe and vc_redist.x86.exe, then restart.
보호 기록에서 격리된 앱 파일 확인 후 복구 설치하기: Check protection history for quarantined app files, then repair-install
보안 프로그램이 앱 폴더의 DLL을 격리하면 런타임이 정상이어도 앱이 필: If security software quarantines a DLL in the app folder, the app cannot find the file it needs even when the runtime is fine.
복구 후 시작되면 끝입니다. 격리 기록이 없고 복구해도 같으면 DLL 이: If it starts after the repair, you are done. If there is no quarantine record and repair does not help, send the DLL name and OS version to the publisher's support.
Windows 보안 → 바이러스 및 위협 방지 → 보호 기록에서 앱 폴더: In Windows Security → Virus & threat protection → Protection history, see whether files from the app folder were quarantined.
격리됐다면 제작사 공식 사이트에서 설치 파일을 새로 받아 복구 설치합니다: If so, download a fresh installer from the publisher's official site and repair-install. If it is quarantined again, ask the publisher whether it is a false positive.
Bad Image 창의 DLL 경로로 앱 파일인지 Windows 파일인지: Use the DLL path in the Bad Image window to tell app files from Windows files
손상된 DLL이 어디에 있는지에 따라 복구 방법이 완전히 다릅니다. 앱: The repair method depends entirely on where the damaged DLL is. If it is in the app folder, repair the app; if it is under C:\Windows, repair Windows.
경로를 확인했으면 해당 단계로 넘어갑니다. DLL을 직접 지우거나 다른: Once you have the path, go to the matching step. Do not delete the DLL or copy one from another PC.
Write down or capture the full path shown in the Bad Image window.
경로가 C:\\Program Files 등 앱 폴더면 다음 단계로 앱을,: If the path is an app folder such as C:\Program Files, repair the app in the next step; if it is C:\Windows\System32 or SysWOW64, repair Windows in the step after that.
앱 폴더 DLL이면 앱을 복구하거나 다시 설치하기: If the DLL is in the app folder, repair or reinstall the app
설치가 중단됐거나 업데이트 중 파일이 일부만 바뀌면 앱 폴더의 DLL이: If an install was interrupted or an update replaced only some files, a DLL in the app folder can become an invalid image.
같은 DLL 경로가 다시 나오지 않으면 끝입니다. 다시 나오면 저장장치: If the same DLL path does not appear again, you are done. If it does, a storage error is also possible, so check the drive with chkdsk C: /scan.
설정 → 앱 → 설치된 앱에서 해당 앱의 ... → 수정(또는 복구)을: In Settings → Apps → Installed apps, run ... → Modify (or Repair) for the app. For Office, run Quick Repair first, then Online Repair.
복구 메뉴가 없으면 제거 후 공식 사이트에서 새로 받은 설치 파일로 다시: If there is no repair option, uninstall and reinstall with a freshly downloaded installer from the official site. For games, the launcher's file check can do the same job.
Windows 파일이면 최근 업데이트 제거 또는 DISM·SFC 실행하기: For a Windows file, uninstall the recent update or run DISM and SFC
Windows 업데이트 직후 System32 DLL로 Bad Image가: There are cases where Bad Image appears for a System32 DLL right after a Windows update. If it began after an update, roll that update back first; otherwise repair the system files.
재시작 후 같은 경로가 다시 나오지 않으면 끝입니다. 제거한 업데이트는: If the same path does not appear after restarting, you are done. Watch whether the removed update reinstalls before Microsoft releases a fix. If the error continues, consider a Windows repair install after backing up.
오류가 업데이트 직후 시작됐다면 설정 → Windows 업데이트 → 업데: If the error started right after an update, remove that date's update in Settings → Windows Update → Update history → Uninstall updates and restart (View update history → Uninstall updates on Windows 10).
업데이트와 관계없다면 터미널(관리자)에서 DISM /Online /Cle: If it is unrelated to an update, run DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth first in Terminal (Admin), then sfc /scannow when it finishes.
관리자 권한 실행으로 권한 문제인지 비교하기: Compare with Run as administrator to see whether it is a permission problem
0xC0000022는 접근 거부입니다. 관리자 권한으로는 실행된다면 현재: 0xC0000022 is an access denial. If the app runs as administrator, the current account likely lacks permission on a needed file or folder. This is only for finding the cause, not a reason to always run as administrator.
관리자 권한이나 다른 계정에서만 실행되면 다음 단계로 설치 폴더 권한을: If it runs only as administrator or from another account, check the install folder's permissions in the next step. If it fails everywhere, check security block records first.
Right-click the app's shortcut and choose Run as administrator.
가능하면 같은 PC의 다른 사용자 계정에서도 실행해 계정별 차이를 봅니다: If possible, also run it from another user account on the same PC to see whether it differs by account.
설치 폴더의 보안 탭에서 읽기 및 실행 권한 확인하기: Check Read & execute permission on the install folder's Security tab
앱을 다른 드라이브로 옮기거나 다른 PC의 폴더를 그대로 복사하면 Use: Moving an app to another drive or copying a folder from another PC as-is can drop the Users group's execute permission.
재설치 후 일반 계정에서 실행되면 끝입니다. 회사 PC에서 권한이 정책으: If it runs from a standard account after reinstalling, you are done. On a work PC where permissions are locked by policy, ask the administrator. If it is still the same, check security blocks next.
앱 설치 폴더를 오른쪽 클릭 → 속성 → 보안 탭에서 Users(또는 현: Right-click the app's install folder → Properties → Security tab, and check that Users (or your account) is allowed Read & execute.
권한이 빠져 있다면 폴더 권한을 직접 바꾸기보다 앱을 제거하고 공식 설치: If the permission is missing, rather than editing folder permissions yourself, uninstall the app and reinstall it to the default path (C:\Program Files) with the official installer.
보안 차단 기록과 제어된 폴더 액세스 확인하기: Check security block records and Controlled folder access
백신이 앱 DLL을 차단하거나, 제어된 폴더 액세스가 앱이 문서 폴더에: Execution can be denied if antivirus blocks an app DLL, or Controlled folder access stops the app from writing to the Documents folder. If several apps are denied together, damaged Windows file permissions are also possible.
허용 후 실행되면 끝입니다. 회사 정책(AppLocker 등)으로 막힌: If it runs after allowing it, you are done. If company policy (such as AppLocker) blocks the app, do not work around it; ask the administrator for approval.
Windows 보안 → 바이러스 및 위협 방지 → 보호 기록에서 이 앱: In Windows Security → Virus & threat protection → Protection history, look for block records for this app's path.
같은 화면의 랜섬웨어 방지 관리 → 제어된 폴더 액세스가 켜져 있고 이: If Manage ransomware protection → Controlled folder access on the same screen is on and this app was blocked, add only the official app under 'Allow an app through Controlled folder access'.
여러 앱이 동시에 0xC0000022로 실패하면 터미널(관리자)에서 sf: If several apps fail with 0xC0000022 at the same time, run sfc /scannow in Terminal (Admin).
Microsoft 공식 vc_redist를 x64·x86 모두 설치하기: Install Microsoft's official vc_redist for both x64 and x86
VCRUNTIME140.dll은 Visual C++ 2015-2022(v: VCRUNTIME140.dll ships in the Visual C++ 2015-2022 (v14) Redistributable. If you do not know whether the app is 32-bit or 64-bit, installing both is the safe choice.
VCRUNTIME140.dll 메시지가 사라지면 끝입니다. 이미 설치돼: If the VCRUNTIME140.dll message is gone, you are done. If the installer says it is already installed, repair the existing package in the next step.
Microsoft Learn의 최신 Visual C++ 재배포 가능 패키: Download vc_redist.x64.exe and vc_redist.x86.exe from the latest Visual C++ Redistributable page on Microsoft Learn. Do not use sites that offer single DLL downloads.
Install both files in turn, restart the PC, and run the app again.
설치된 Visual C++ 2015-2022 패키지 복구하기: Repair the installed Visual C++ 2015-2022 package
패키지는 설치돼 있는데 파일이 손상되거나 지워졌다면 새로 설치하려 해도: If the package is installed but its files are damaged or deleted, a new install just says it is already there. Running Repair is what puts the files back.
복구 후 앱이 실행되면 끝입니다. 계속되면 다음 단계로 앱 설치 프로그램: If the app runs after the repair, you are done. If not, reinstall the dependencies the app's installer provides in the next step.
설정 → 앱 → 설치된 앱에서 'Microsoft Visual C++ 2: In Settings → Apps → Installed apps, click ... → Modify for 'Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable (x64)' and choose Repair (Apps & features on Windows 10).
Repair the (x86) entry the same way and restart.
앱 설치 프로그램을 다시 실행해 의존성 복원하기: Run the app installer again to restore dependencies
일부 앱은 VCRUNTIME140.dll을 자기 폴더에 함께 넣어 배포합: Some apps ship VCRUNTIME140.dll in their own folder. If that copy was deleted, the app needs to be repaired separately from the Windows package.
복구 후 실행되면 끝입니다. 그래도 같은 메시지면 Windows 보안 보: If it runs after the repair, you are done. If the message remains, check Windows Security protection history for a quarantine of this file and contact the publisher.
앱의 설치된 앱 항목에서 수정·복구를 실행하거나, 공식 사이트에서 받은: Run Modify/Repair from the app's Installed apps entry, or install over it with an installer from the official site.
게임은 Steam의 게임 파일 무결성 확인이나 런처의 복구 기능을 실행합: For games, run Verify integrity of game files on Steam or the launcher's repair feature.
설치된 Visual C++ 패키지 버전과 x64 여부 확인하기: Check the installed Visual C++ package version and whether x64 is present
VCRUNTIME140_1.dll은 64비트(x64) 패키지에만 들어 있: VCRUNTIME140_1.dll is included only in the 64-bit (x64) package and is absent from old 2015 and 2017 packages. That is why new 64-bit apps fail on PCs that have only VCRUNTIME140.dll.
x64 항목이 없거나 오래됐다면 다음 단계로 최신 x64 패키지를 설치합: If there is no x64 entry or it is old, install the latest x64 package in the next step. If the latest x64 is already there, repair it in the step after that.
Search for 'Visual C++' in Settings → Apps → Installed apps.
(x64) 항목이 있는지, 이름이 2015나 2017로만 돼 있거나 버전: Check whether an (x64) entry exists, and whether its name says only 2015 or 2017 or its version number is below 14.2.
최신 2015-2022 x64 패키지는 이전 v14 패키지를 대체하며 V: The latest 2015-2022 x64 package replaces earlier v14 packages and installs VCRUNTIME140_1.dll along with it.
메시지 없이 실행되면 끝입니다. 이미 최신이라고 나오거나 같은 오류가 나: If it runs without the message, you are done. If it says the latest version is already installed or the error remains, repair the package in the next step.
Microsoft Learn의 최신 지원 Visual C++ 다운로드 문: Download and run vc_redist.x64.exe for x64 from the latest supported Visual C++ downloads page on Microsoft Learn.
설치가 끝나면 PC를 재시작하고 앱을 다시 실행합니다. 32비트 앱도 함: When the install finishes, restart the PC and run the app again. If you also use 32-bit apps, install vc_redist.x86.exe as well.
x64 패키지를 복구하고 앱을 다시 설치하기: Repair the x64 package and reinstall the app
최신 패키지가 있는데도 파일이 없다고 나오면 패키지 파일이 손상됐거나 앱: If the file is reported missing even with the latest package, the package files may be damaged, or the app may be loading an old copy from its own folder first.
복구 후 실행되면 끝입니다. 계속되면 앱이 지원하는 Windows 버전과: If it runs after the repair, you are done. If not, recheck the Windows versions and architectures the app supports in the publisher's requirements.
설치된 앱의 'Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 R: Run Modify → Repair on 'Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable (x64)' in Installed apps and restart.
그래도 같으면 앱을 공식 설치 파일로 복구 설치하거나 런처의 파일 검사를: If it is still the same, repair-install the app with its official installer or run the launcher's file check.
Visual C++ 2015-2022 패키지를 두 아키텍처 모두 설치하기: Install the Visual C++ 2015-2022 package for both architectures
MSVCP140.dll은 Visual C++ v14 패키지의 C++ 표준: MSVCP140.dll is the C++ standard library in the Visual C++ v14 package. A game's launcher can be 32-bit while the game itself is 64-bit, so installing only one side can keep failing.
표준 라이브러리 오류가 사라지면 끝입니다. 남아 있으면 다음 단계로 게임: If the standard library error is gone, you are done. If it remains, run the redistributable installer inside the game folder in the next step. Do not remove older Visual C++ versions other apps use.
Microsoft Learn에서 vc_redist.x64.exe와 vc_: Get vc_redist.x64.exe and vc_redist.x86.exe from Microsoft Learn and install both. If it says they are already installed, choose Repair.
Restart, then run the game or program again.
게임 폴더의 재배포 설치 파일과 파일 검사 실행하기: Run the redistributable installer in the game folder and check files
게임은 개발 당시 기준의 Visual C++ 설치 파일을 함께 제공합니다: Games bundle the Visual C++ installer they were built against. If that install was cancelled on first launch, the component can be missing.
실행되면 끝입니다. 계속되면 다음 단계로 보안 프로그램이 파일을 격리했는: If it runs, you are done. If not, check in the next step whether security software quarantined the file.
게임 설치 폴더의 _CommonRedist\\vcredist 아래 설치: Run the installers (vc_redist.x64.exe and vc_redist.x86.exe) under _CommonRedist\vcredist in the game's install folder. The folder name can differ by game.
Steam은 게임 파일 무결성 확인, 다른 런처는 복구·검사 기능으로 설: Check the install folder's files with Verify integrity of game files on Steam, or the repair/verify feature of other launchers.
보안 프로그램이 MSVCP140.dll을 격리했는지 확인하기: Check whether security software quarantined MSVCP140.dll
게임 폴더에 함께 들어 있는 MSVCP140.dll이 오탐으로 격리되면: If the MSVCP140.dll bundled in a game folder is quarantined as a false positive, that game alone can keep showing the error even after the runtime is reinstalled.
격리 기록이 없고 앞 단계로도 해결되지 않으면 게임 버전과 오류 창 캡처: If there is no quarantine record and the earlier steps did not help, send the game version and a screenshot of the error window to the developer.
Windows 보안 → 바이러스 및 위협 방지 → 보호 기록에서 MSVC: In Windows Security → Virus & threat protection → Protection history, look for entries mentioning MSVCP140.dll or the game folder path. For other antivirus, check that program's quarantine list.
기록이 있으면 격리 파일을 되살리지 말고 공식 런처에서 파일 검사를 다시: If there is a record, do not restore the quarantined file; run the official launcher's file check again to get a clean copy. If it is quarantined again, tell the antivirus vendor and the game developer.
Visual C++ 2013 재배포 패키지를 앱 아키텍처에 맞게 설치하기: Install the Visual C++ 2013 Redistributable that matches the app's architecture

이름이 Microsoft.VC로 시작하면 다음 단계에서 해당 Visual: If the name starts with Microsoft.VC, install that Visual C++ version in the next step. If it is a different name, it may be one of the app's own components, so move on to repairing the app.
Win + X → 이벤트 뷰어 → Windows 로그 → 응용 프로그램에: Open Win + X → Event Viewer → Windows Logs → Application and open the entry with source SideBySide at the time of the error.
'종속 어셈블리' 부분의 이름(예: Microsoft.VC90.CRT),: Note the name in the dependent assembly part (for example Microsoft.VC90.CRT), its version, and processorArchitecture (x86 or amd64).
기록에 맞는 Visual C++ 버전과 아키텍처 설치하기: Install the Visual C++ version and architecture that match the log
어셈블리 이름의 숫자가 Visual C++ 버전을 알려 줍니다. VC80: The number in the assembly name tells you the Visual C++ version: VC80 is 2005 and VC90 is 2008, and the latest 2015-2022 package does not replace them.
앱이 실행되고 같은 SideBySide 기록이 새로 생기지 않으면 끝입니: If the app runs and no new identical SideBySide entry appears, you are done. If it continues, repair the app and look closer with sxstrace in the next step.
Microsoft Learn의 Visual C++ 다운로드 문서에서 해당: On Microsoft Learn's Visual C++ downloads page, find the redistributable for that year (for example Visual Studio 2008 SP1 for VC90).
기록의 processorArchitecture가 x86이면 x86 패키지: If processorArchitecture in the log is x86, install the x86 package; if it is amd64, install the x64 package, then restart.
앱을 복구 설치하고 sxstrace로 추적하기: Repair-install the app and trace it with sxstrace
앱의 매니페스트가 손상됐거나 앱 폴더에 넣은 런타임 파일이 맞지 않으면: If the app's manifest is damaged or runtime files placed in its folder do not match, the error remains even after installing the runtime. sxstrace shows step by step which assembly lookup failed.
ERROR 줄의 어셈블리를 설치해 해결되면 끝입니다. 해결되지 않으면 s: If installing the assembly on the ERROR line fixes it, you are done. If not, send sxs.txt and the SideBySide event details to the publisher.
설정 → 앱 → 설치된 앱에서 해당 앱을 수정·복구하거나 공식 설치 파일: Modify/Repair the app in Settings → Apps → Installed apps, or reinstall it with the official installer.
그래도 같으면 터미널(관리자)에서 sxstrace trace -logfi: If it is still the same, run sxstrace trace -logfile:sxs.etl in Terminal (Admin), launch the app once while it runs, then press Enter in the terminal to stop tracing.
sxstrace parse -logfile:sxs.etl -outfile: Create a readable file with sxstrace parse -logfile:sxs.etl -outfile:sxs.txt, then find the ERROR lines in Notepad.

되돌리기 어렵거나 부품·설정을 직접 다루는 작업입니다. 자신이 없으면 여: These steps are hard to undo or involve working with hardware or system settings directly. If you are not confident, you can take your results so far to a repair service instead.
If the same problem comes back, start again from step {n} on this page.
“CPU LED 켜짐”이 보이면 해당 부품 초기화 실패, 전원 또는 장착: If you see “CPU LED on,” you may suspect that the component has failed to initialize, or has poor power or installation. Distinguish between the POST stage and the Windows startup stage, then check in that order: external device, boot settings, and recovery environment.
“no bootable device”가 보이면 BIOS가 시스템 드라이브: If you see “no bootable device”, you may suspect that the BIOS cannot find the system drive or that there is a mismatch in UEFI/Legacy settings. First check if the system drive is visible in the BIOS, then proceed with the boot sequence and Windows recovery.
“검은 화면 깜빡이는 커서”가 보이면 BIOS가 올바른 부팅 장치를 찾지: If you see a “black screen with a blinking cursor”, you may have a problem with the BIOS not finding the correct boot device, boot area, or drive. First check if the system drive is visible in the BIOS, then proceed with the boot sequence and Windows recovery.
“모니터 전원은 들어옴 검은화면”이 보이면 입력 신호 없음, 밝기 또는: If you see “monitor power on but black screen”, you may suspect a problem with no input signal, brightness, or panel. Cross-testing the input source, cables, ports, and then other monitors can help isolate output device and PC issues.
“로그인하면 검은화면”이 보이면 사용자 프로필 또는 Explorer 문제: If you see a “black screen when logging in,” it may be a problem with your user profile, Explorer, or display output settings. First check if Windows is running, then check the output mode and graphics driver in that order.
“화면 깜빡임”이 보이면 그래픽 드라이버, 주사율 또는 케이블 문제 쪽을: If you see “screen flickering,” it could be a graphics driver, refresh rate, or cable issue. Resolution, refresh rate, HDR, VRR and cable bandwidth must be checked together to distinguish between setup issues and hardware limitations.
“절전 후 화면 안나옴”이 보이면 그래픽 드라이버 전원 관리, 모니터 핸: If you see “No screen after power saving”, you may suspect something related to graphics driver power management or monitor handshake. Check at which stage it fails during sleep entry and exit, and check the driver, power policy, and BIOS in that order.
“driver timeout”가 보이면 드라이버 불안정, GPU 과열 또: If you see “driver timeout”, it could be driver instability, GPU overheating, or overclocking. Compare the graphics driver version, installation status, output environment, and tuning settings one by one.
“GPU 사용률 낮음”이 보이면 CPU 병목, 프레임 제한 또는 전원 설: If you see “GPU Utilization Low” you may be suspecting a CPU bottleneck, frame throttling, or power settings. Check GPU usage, temperature, clock, and game settings together to find the cause of performance limitations.
“게임 실행 안됨”이 보이면 게임 파일 손상, 필수 런타임 또는 권한 문: If you see “Game won’t launch”, you may have corrupted game files, required runtime, or permission issues. Check error messages, game files, graphics drivers, overlays and hardware stability in that order.
“게임할때만 재부팅”이 보이면 파워서플라이 또는 GPU 전력 문제, 과열: If you see “Reboot only when playing games,” you may suspect a power supply or GPU power issue, or overheating. Check error messages, game files, graphics drivers, overlays and hardware stability in that order.
“CPU 100퍼”가 보이면 특정 프로세스 과부하, 백그라운드 업데이트: If you see “CPU 100%”, you may suspect a specific process overload or background update. Check process load, power mode, temperature and clock together to distinguish between software load and hardware limitations.
“디스크 100퍼”가 보이면 백그라운드 I/O, 저장장치 응답 지연 쪽을: If you see “Disk 100%”, you can suspect background I/O or storage device response delay. Check the processes using the disk, free space, connection speed and SMART in that order.
“HDD 인식 안됨”이 보이면 SATA 데이터·전원 케이블 문제, 포트: If you see “HDD not recognized,” you may suspect a problem with the SATA data/power cable, port or drive failure. Check the recognition location in BIOS and Disk Management and cross-test cables, ports, and slots.
“SSD 100% 프리징”이 보이면 저장장치 응답 지연 또는 고장, 스토: If you see “SSD 100% freezing,” you may suspect storage device response delay or failure, or the storage driver. Prioritize backing up important data, then check the actual drive status using SMART and manufacturer diagnostics.
“32GB인데 16GB”가 보이면 모듈·슬롯 접촉 문제, 메모리 예약 쪽: If you see “16GB even though it is 32GB”, you may suspect a module/slot contact issue or memory reservation. After returning memory settings such as XMP/EXPO to default, perform diagnostics and module/slot cross-testing.
“랜덤 크래시”가 보이면 불량 RAM 모듈 또는 슬롯, XMP·EXPO: If you see “random crashes,” you may suspect a bad RAM module or slot, or XMP/EXPO instability. After returning memory settings such as XMP/EXPO to default, perform diagnostics and module/slot cross-testing.
“CPU 온도 높음”이 보이면 쿨러 장착 또는 팬 문제, 먼지·서멀 상태: If you see “CPU temperature high”, you may suspect a cooler installation, fan problem, or dust/thermal condition. Temporarily reduce high loads, check the temperature, fan, and ventilation conditions, and then check the cooling system and power settings.
“인터넷 안됨”이 보이면 공유기·모뎀 또는 ISP 문제, 네트워크 어댑터: If you see “No Internet”, you may suspect a problem with your router, modem, or ISP, or a problem with your network adapter, IP, or DNS settings. Compare with other devices and wired connections to narrow down where the problem occurs: PC, router, or ISP.
“와이파이 안보임”이 보이면 무선 어댑터 비활성화, 드라이버 또는 하드웨: If you see “No Wi-Fi”, you may have a wireless adapter disabled, driver, or hardware issue. Check the wireless adapter status, saved profiles, router/signal quality, and driver in order.
“와이파이 느림”이 보이면 약한 신호·간섭, 2.4GHz 혼잡 쪽을 의심: If you see “slow Wi-Fi,” you may suspect weak signals, interference, or 2.4GHz congestion. Check the wireless adapter status, saved profiles, router/signal quality, and driver in order.
“공유폴더 접속 안됨”이 보이면 네트워크 프로필·자격 증명, SMB 설정: If you see “No access to shared folder”, you may be suspicious of your network profile/credentials or SMB settings. Compare with other devices and wired connections to narrow down where the problem occurs: PC, router, or ISP.
“블루투스 자꾸 끊김”이 보이면 전원 절약, 드라이버 쪽을 의심해 볼 수: If you see “Bluetooth keeps disconnecting,” you may suspect power saving or the driver. After resetting the Bluetooth power status and pairing information, check for problems with the driver, interference, or the device itself.
“USB 인식 안됨”이 보이면 포트·케이블 문제, USB 드라이버 쪽을: If you see “USB not recognized,” you may suspect a problem with the port/cable or USB driver. Cross-test devices, cables, and USB ports and check for power management and driver issues.
“USB 자꾸 끊김”이 보이면 USB 전원 관리, 허브·케이블 쪽을 의심: If you see “USB keeps disconnecting,” you may suspect something related to USB power management or the hub/cable. Cross-test devices, cables, and USB ports and check for power management and driver issues.
“키보드 안됨”이 보이면 USB·Bluetooth 연결, 드라이버 쪽을: If you see “Keyboard not working”, you can suspect the USB/Bluetooth connection or driver. Compare with other ports and other PCs to distinguish between problems with the keyboard itself and problems with Windows input settings and drivers.
“SD카드 쓰기금지”가 보이면 잠금 스위치, 파일시스템·컨트롤러 보호 상: If you see “SD card write prohibited”, you may suspect the lock switch or file system/controller protection status. Cross-test cards, readers, and ports, and if you need existing data, prioritize backup and recovery over formatting.
“소리 지직”이 보이면 드라이버·샘플링 설정, 오디오 향상 기능 쪽을 의: If you see “sound crackling,” you may suspect driver/sampling settings or audio enhancement features. Check everything in order, from output device selection and volume mixer to problems with drivers, cables, and the device itself.
“프린터 인식 안됨”이 보이면 USB·네트워크 연결, 프린터 드라이버 쪽: If you see “Printer not recognized,” you may suspect the USB/network connection or printer driver. If you check the printer status and connection, print queue, and driver in that order, it is easy to tell whether the problem is with the PC or the printer.
“프린터 느림”이 보이면 고해상도 품질 설정, 네트워크 연결 쪽을 의심해: If you see “Printer Slow”, you may suspect the high-resolution quality setting or network connection. If you check the printer status and connection, print queue, and driver in that order, it is easy to tell whether the problem is with the PC or the printer.
“팬 계속 돎”이 보이면 백그라운드 CPU 사용, 열 프로필·BIOS 쪽: If you see “Fan keeps running”, you may suspect background CPU usage, thermal profile, or BIOS. Temporarily reduce high loads, check the temperature, fan, and ventilation conditions, and then check the cooling system and power settings.
“노트북 과열 꺼짐”이 보이면 열 보호 동작, 막힌 통풍구·팬 문제 쪽을: If you see “Laptop overheating and turns off,” you may suspect a problem with thermal protection, clogged vents, or fans. Temporarily reduce high loads, check the temperature, fan, and ventilation conditions, and then check the cooling system and power settings.
